sections.h:
• I am lost, there is no more hope. Everything is finished! My God, how can I describe what it left inside me! The unrest was renewed and was much stronger;

everything brought fidgets. It seemed as if all my nerves moved.

111 Certainly, this must be a person who will || bring me much affliction with her/his death, because I feel she/he is someone that belongs to me. Oh, what pains! I was feeling so tired in waking up that I feared I would not stand on my feet but I managed to do so.

Acts of reparation in the Catholic world for the offences to the Church

112 After Holy Communion and much more in the hour of adoration that I did, I was strengthened and I was able to continue to stay on my feet and now late at night I feel heavy but my head is free || for writing.

Moreover, I will be able to prepare myself for tomorrow since I will have much work, which I had in the whole day that passed. It was such that on all sides I felt new pain: there was someone who wanted something but I was aware that it was not the will of my Good, and therefore I did not allow it. I would destroy myself rather than allow something that did not please my Good. That is how I always had to fight, but without human respect and bring victory. ||

113 Today, I seemed to see many things that the heart of my Lord and sweet Love received from the good souls that were a big quantity and the dear Saviour was pleased. 114 In a moment I saw very clearly that the Blessed Trinity was pleased with the offerings the good souls made as reparation. It was a very big number as if they did not want to allow any comparison with the present heresies of Bruno’s9 || monument. For this reparation that the whole Catholic world made in keeping united to the bride of the Redeemer, the Church and to the supreme Pontiff my merciful God rejoiced.

Oh, my sweetest Love, I would have liked to do much but my role does not allow me to; I can say nothing. 115 Oh, how I feel that I would willingly be united with the good souls || and witness my gratitude to you by reparation, penances, discipline and many ill-treatments. But I am so sick these days that I must resign and first offer you the obedience that was not always possible because of my sickness. 116 And all the sufferings that I carry in the whole body that I can say there is no side which has not its pain.

Today even my poor head || is swollen but I offered the pain to my Good and I said:

  • May God do with me what he wants, that of this sickness may become what he wishes.

Resigned I stay in him where I desire nothing. In everything I feel repugnance and a true pain. In my dear

Beloved I find my paradise. 117 Oh, my Love || I want only you!

Tied by obedience to the director who is far

10 June 1889. I am oppressed by much affliction and it seems to me that my God, my sweet Love does not listen to me anymore and does not give me what I desire much and this because of my carelessness. In these few hours it seemed to me that everything gave me infinite pain because of being alone and because of my wickedness I drive away my Good. Therefore what should I do? 118 Oh, I would discipline myself || until bleeding and I would be more sensible; but what about obedience? After I will have more scruples and I truly see a crowd of ill-founded fears, but that is no less painful anxiety; the superficial thought that I could have of having offended my Good. No, no! How painful is my life, always without a person to whom I can say a word || that can guide me. 119 He is so far away that I can rarely say a word and be comforted and assured. Oh, my

Love, do not delay to come and comfort this poor slave of yours who lives only for you, Being of my life!

Rome 10 June 1889.

MS 11.1 – pp. 1-68

“I regret to fill these pages with narrations of pains and torments”

1/2 14 September 1889. For three months I did not write any

1/2 more because I have been oppressed by sufferings, continuous pains and tribulations of every kind which took place repeatedly with every kind of accusation. At the end I did not want to start this book narrating painful things; I had always resisted any impulse, rather than narrating my continuous pains without any comfort.

Alone! 3 But for the continuous impulse which from my own understanding seemed || to come from my Good and it is persistent, I could almost say threatening, I submit myself to write.

However, I regret to fill these pages with narrations all about suffering and torment of every kind.

Interior sufferings, painful presages:

abandonment by God

I left Rome and in the visits to Naples and the surrounding area I had visits accompanied by pains, because the devil always under different forms tormented me and from that I could understand what was going to happen to me. By now I know from the impressions that I receive, I understand how and what I will experience.

4 I visited the sanctuary of Loreto and I prayed much || but always accompanied by great pain because while the other times I had consolation, this time I had only aridity and interior pains such that it seemed to me I had not been heard by my Love.

It seems as if even the Virgin Mary put me off and does not want to listen to me. I suffered so much that I had a bit of fever and an illness in my whole being; I was horribly swollen.

I felt nothing within me that could come from my Good but I had a worry so strong that I was || unable to breathe.

5 The sight of painful things that were to happen to me interiorly caused me the bitterness of death.

My sufferings and the thought of being abandoned by my Good overcame all the other atrocious torments. I would have destroyed myself by the discipline until bleeding, but even this satisfaction was taken away from me and I had not a thread of strength. Whenever I tried, within an instant I fainted and a strong trembling shook the whole of my being.

|| 6 Abandoned on the poor little bed I entrusted myself to God. The swelling increased such that the chain that I carried was deep inside the flesh. That pain gave me much satisfaction and I had made a point not to loosen it. But my God reduced the pain and everything returned as before;

otherwise it could have remained in the flesh. What did I feel? Horrid spasms. But when the Cardinal Protector seeing me so swollen ordered to change the weather || I did. 7 In fact, after some days the swelling was reduced and the chain came out of the flesh; I also helped to take it out by removing it with care and in that way I was not obliged to remove it, because they could realize. I was as well as before, not fully but at least I was able to breathe.

At night the beasts always run up and down by the wall and sometimes they rushed as if to come upon me and are of all kinds: women, lay people, men and P.V.; they are of all types. || 8 These more or less bring me suffering. It is truly a torment so sensible that it takes away my life in such a way that I feel not to have strength to live and it is the reason for which I always say that I have no more life. But I see that I live. It is something sure that in me I feel there is someone who lives for me.

An offering to God of the sufferings, penances, and worries of the work

I find peace only in solitude and everything else is boredom. 9 But I am always firm || and resigned not to say anything and suffer though faith assures me of being with my God. I feel so happy to have always new sufferings so that I can offer them in the morning when I make the offering of all the suffering I had during the night and through out the twenty-four hours; I try to make it acceptable saying:

  • 10 I offer to you my sufferings, the tribulations, the pains that I had and I still have; again I offer to you all the penances and the worry I have for your Work I unite with the sufferings || of Jesus Christ your Son. For his infinite sufferings, I beg you to deign to pour upon me your mercy and covered with this, I will be worthy to receive the gifts of the Holy Spirit and in this way become worthy of your attention.

11 Yes, Jesus my Love, I go to work in your delicious vineyard; make in a way that your slave may plant nothing other than fruitful plants; that the fruits may please you, that the flowers may be of such beauty and fragrance that the whole paradise may delight in such sweetness. || May no plant be spoiled because of me but may my work find ways to consolidate them in roots of your true pleasure.

As I go to work, with my head to the ground I beg for your blessing; but every where I turn I see nothing else but big thorns that are frightening because of their thorny twisting.

Stars and other signs of souls that ask for help

A big star appeared to me now. 12 Alas, a superior who will go to heaven and will leave me another empty place! How could one reach || such pain!

Well, my love, do you want me to be prepared? Here I am! I saw other small stars and at the end a skull and still others; and these are all my companions.

They stop and I question them; if I realize that they need prayers I promise them and at night I try to pray for I am unable to sleep.

Moreover my side rises up often and I can say some vocal prayers, not much but the rosary… Because who comes to ask… ||

13 My God, therefore, all the relatives, all the Daughters of St. Anne, the people who know me and also all those who reign! It is curious that you bring me the black souls which go to… What pains! What can I do? Pray so that they may be converted but when I say that they pass, is this not one of the painful sufferings? 14 But with the heap of the others and everyone brings its sensible pain || as the pains for certain people, who after having received much good they offer me nothing other than certain stabs, and I feel so weary that I find nothing that could lift me up.

When it seems I am going to faint suddenly there is a small union with my Good. Soon I feel my ribs lifted and I am fully in him. I remain strengthened but how long does it take? 15 Ten minutes and then again || to the ground of anguishes and terrible sufferings.

Alone! I feel an extreme need of a bit of peace and I can never find it because the Work of my God is such that it does not give me a minute of breath.

Continually I have new torments and today I feel a bit more strength and can bear the sufferings with less anxiety.

All the same a crowd of tribulations wanted to oppress me.

My Good having furnished me with strength, with his help I hope to be able to overcome. 16 How much I suffer when a sister speaks to me and I see and feel || clearly that she says what is not in her heart; it is painful… One can realize when a person and even a sister, speaks from the heart! It certainly gives joy to speak and instruct her on the manner of behaving.

Longing for the small room of Piacenza

What displeasure to leave my room! It is now two summers that I have come to Piacenza. I feel happy to be able to release myself a bit in my dear room. Because of serious reasons of health, 17 and of obedience, I must leave and go always to work where this ass can feel better. || In this way I must be deprived of the relief for my tossed spirit in that my soul is left between two big stones and the suffering seems to oppress me. Oh, what a mystery is this!

Do you deprive me even of this relief, my Love? My Crucifix, perhaps, when I managed to 18 embrace you in that cell where I received much comfort… Do you take away everything || now?

The swelling I had was such that I passed the nights in continuous spasm; during the day I was reduced to a point that I was unable to move. Seated I suffered because in the whole body, as I moved I was feeling the skin opening. Oh the pains were truly spasmodic and they suffocated my breathing.

19 After staying out for a month, the swelling had gone down but as I came back || on the second day I started swelling again and at night there were pains. I was unable to work and again I was feeling worry…

Again I worked to change the weather and for some days I have been here in a small house but very big because my Good is close to me.

20 I work much because I am near to Piacenza; it is as if I were in the Mother House. I keep with me my sisters, alone in a sweet solitude, but it is not my cell. Picenza! I find || that the swelling decreases every day and the worry has disappeared. I hope much to go back!

My Good, why this? Perhaps it was of relief for me and you my sweet love did not want it? Resigned I feel happy in suffering and I find sweet everything that I receive from your hands.10

“The annoyances of a person who always seeks to frighten me with continues threats”

21 The annoyance of a person who though already outside the Institute seeks always to frighten me with his threats, || making me anxious for the grave sufferings which will happen to me continues. My Good, what can come to me more than those which I have on all sides! I seem to be in the middle of a cart where every kind of fire seems to come and a grape-shot of new inventions. Not a single suffering and tribulation is similar to the others. They are always new and some are so odd and unexpected that I truly stop to consider them. 22 Within me I go on saying: ||

  • How can this thing which hurts me so much arise?

Who could have said that this person, whom I benefited much, had studied to do such terrible actions to his own soul’s disadvantage? Because in order to put together certain things which never existed, one must think and so with knowledge; I can say this because more than once I received this from the Daughters of St. Anne. 23 The same happened to other people to invent what I said above and then because of God’s mercy || touched by grace and coming back to themselves they came to me to ask me for forgiveness telling me that they had invented everything in their mind and then manifested them to hurt me. To do that they felt a strong impulse such that they were not able to resist it; they were forced to agree. I felt pity to see them weeping and they were so regretful, I truly felt compassion. I comforted them with sincere affection when I was able.

24 In this way my Love || allows that I must repair. How and which means should I use? I frequently examine myself to see if there are faults of prudence or others which have been given chance, but I do not find them. I even try to be always careful and I can say that I speak rarely except with my secretaries. I speak neither with the sisters nor with the lay. 25 These last I keep away || completely and I have difficulty to speak to them unless forced by the affaires of the Work. I always try to be hidden from all and to speak little or nothing because I think on everything that I say; not only once but many times I keep quiet for fear of failing. 26 Finally I find that the more I hide, the more I enjoy peace and calm. In the midst of much work and such continued battles my soul delights in peace and calm of conscience such that it keeps me resigned || to receive these shootings. I am calm and in peace; I receive everything even if I feel them so much and I find that the more I grow older the more I am sensible; many times I weep while before, I was never depressed! Now yes, and I have deep sensitivity: I have no more strength to overcome. They realize and I am upset; the strength fails me…

27 I feel that my nerves have suffered much and have become very weak. || 28 [unnumbered blank page]

|| I judge it this way and from what I feel I have confirmation such that I could say I always feel something that frightens me; every small thing happens without my willing it. I fear and I become like ice with interior trembling… Oh, how I suffer!

29 I would like to speak in details about what happened to me in these months but I understand I would tire my poor head || to find the exact dates of what I saw and received. I do not feel confident because I always feel that I would fail in being exact. I do not even want to force the mind because my poor head is suffering so much and continuously pains me for small things.

In these days as usual, I have much work; 30 in this way I leave… if my Good will give me strength and a bit of courage not to be overcome || as I did in the past months, I will write as I did in the past. I do not say always, because sometimes it happens to me as now. Oh, how my situation is so sorrowful, without any kind of comfort!

The world judged that I did not want it which was very different! 31 What apparently seemed of comfort instead were || years of true martyrdom and only my good is witness of my painful suffering!11

“I understand well that what happened to me is something serious: it is exhaustion”

23 September. What days of tribulation and of real pains without exception! My poor spirit is bombarded in a terrible way without any comfort in darkness without understanding what to do. My God, this time the martyrdom is truly long and painful. My mind is already upset at the thought of being abandoned by its Good. || At this thought, what sadness! It is very painful! 32 On all sides where I turn I do not see anything but darkness. The afflictions are many and it seems everything plots against me. I feel a deep melancholy that when I work much especially speaking and listening to the sisters and having to correct them, how my poor head suffers! 33 Yesterday the suffering was so much that the pain I felt within me was much more than the || headache and it left me much depressed.

The pain caused by speaking does not cease, I could say that it is as if the skull is emptied and the brain consumed.

What is experienced in such terrible pain! I am not in a position to speak or to pray. 34 After making an effort to take something, it seems to me that slowly it is filled and after some hours I can again think || but I remain very tired and for that day I cannot commit myself seriously; only to things of little importance can I commit myself as I did yesterday.

This is how I suffered this morning, because I had to speak with a superior of very important things. How much I suffered, my God! This is a terrible pain and I experience it frequently and with toughness.

35 When it happens I understand well || that it is something serious and only my God can heal me because it is exhausting. Only my dear Crucifix can heal me filling the emptiness of my poor head.

Grief for an “old and ugly” sister who ran away with a sick person

Oh, how these ugly beasts sign the events! Horrible monsters!

It is 25 days since I saw one of these beasts that indicated to me the running away of a sister and left me little or nothing of pain; only an interior pain for her soul. I felt it very clearly!

36 In that moment || the visitor returned from the house where there was a young sister whom I feared; instead there was another one who acted on behalf of the superior who was sick. She was old and ugly that is how they called her in that hospital, ugly as a devil; she went with one with tuberculosis. My God, she was more than forty years old, she was truly ugly! What a terrible fact to be alone with men while our rule prohibits it!

37 It is well seen that the || Holy Mother had provided for our health in all the points of the holy Rule!

Oh, how terrible is the devil; it tempts even in a filthy manner. It is the first case of an old sister. My God it is really a terrible pain! How I suffer! The fear…

By now everything is unbridled against your Work, my God!

38 The fear of being the cause afflicts me and brings me an unbelievable pain; I pray, offer penances and fasting but they are useless. ||

Longing to see the Daughters of St. Anne as many fruitful plants

26 September. I received the news of the death of a prince of the Church and this came some days ago. All pass away even the Cardinal Schiaffino. What sorrow I felt! In this way in his young age, my God! He worked much for his Order and for the Church. 39 It was painful when I saw the miter and the skull; I understood nothing, I feared the death of another and my thought never fell on him.12 ||

The melancholy is always much and it oppresses me; it is such that having to stay with the sisters the nerves in my head tighten and I feel pain. When I can I close myself for a while and I feel that I am calm; I remain strong in order to face other battles that I have to bear. There are certain moments in which I do not understand what happens in me and I am not even able to explain it. || 40 I would like to disengage; I do not know, something keeps me in my God.

Alone I go on thinking: therefore if that is the way I found myself in that moment, my Good was with me and he still made me share in his divine mercy. It seems to me that everything goes well and everything is well done for my God. Oh, if I could be able to give him pleasure and see everything accomplished for his greater || glory!

41 Oh, only this is enough, my Good, to satisfy you in everything! To see a Daughter of St. Anne who runs speedily on the way of holiness, how I feel glad! My consolation is to see that everything is done for your greater glory; what I feel!

The consolation is great in me and I feel nothing that comforts me. 42 Only this || I feel to be of consolation for me.

Oh, if I could be able to make them or rather to see them all fruitful plants of sweet and tasteful fruits, sweet to your taste my Good. Oh, I would be happy! I desire nothing more; I want to desire nothing on this earth except new fruits and flowers, all gracious and pleasing to you!

43 But when || some of these plants, instead of producing deep roots dry out and I see them altered and burned by the diabolic snares, they become ashes and return back to the dust of the world. Horrible disgrace! 44 How much they make me suffer! I feel true pain and a terrible torture and I lament against myself and I have a thousand fears for not having on time given to those plants || a support, a suitable nourishment so that they may not perish. They are serious pains for me who fears disgusting the Being of my life, my sweet Beloved.

A night of mortal anguishes and of ghosts

28 September: eve of St. Michael. I thought I was dying for the pain was much. I had to call and for pity’s sake I had to ask for help. There was no need of saying many things because as soon as the secretary, angel of goodness heard me she gave me help with affection. 45 Towards four in the morning I felt stronger || and I asked the sisters to leave me and go to sleep. I felt better and in fact I seemed to sleep.

As soon as they left I stayed drowsy, half-asleep. There was a shaking, I opened my eyes: My God, how many beasts over my head! Big, small and all with wings and the sword as for St. Michael in the act of killing. 46 But their wings were like those of a bat, the mouth was || big; they had a black beak. Those which were over my head, except one which was discreetly big, they were small and one was apart on the right side. 47 This was very big and approached me with sharpened sword; instead of wounding me the sword fell and remained lightly attached to the (…)

|| Confused it ran away and left me something which I cannot describe. Every pain that a body can suffer, unrest, pain and spasm came upon me.

Whom will I call and what will I say? Poor creatures, how much they will suffer!

Oh, dear St. Michael, the annoyance that those ugly spirits tried to give you! 48 My dear angel, prince of the heavenly court, you deign to take care of this poor miserable || creature, defend me from such atrocious battles which these ugly evils announce that I will be exhausted of strength and taken by fear.

I suffered a terrible pain! And it always went on increasing. What spasms, my God! They stayed until this morning, for three days. But I am still expecting a greater pain.

Deprived even of the consolation of the room of Piacenza

20 October. I am again in my dear cell. Oh, what I feel!

//

49 I would like to describe what my Master does when he does not want me to remain in one place. He does not give me peace anymore, though I stay very happy, because I find benefit for my health or other things. 50 But if my master and Lord does not want me to stay anymore I must say what I did today at the foot of his altar: - I go because you do not want me anymore; you want to give me not even a day of calm, || you leave me always in the midst of struggles and unrest.

That is what pleases to you. Oh, how happy I feel in doing everything according to your will in order to be able to do things that are pleasing to your most divine heart!

3 October. I have returned to my dear cell where I feel some kind of consolation and union with God…

I will also narrate the many memories…

51 Oh, my Love, || why do you want to deprive me of even this small consolation or rather relief to my many pains? For two years you have allowed this and it will be of much pain if it continues to happen like this. And yet for two years coming from Rome with the hope of staying in this cell, you always made me sick and in this way I must leave again because as soon as I am away I am healed and I can work.

What a mystery!

52 Moreover you keep me so much in the dark; || regarding this I understand nothing and I feel oppressed thinking that in this cell I poured out many tears and I received much consolation. It was the place where I released and I did my penances. Everything has been taken away, well, even this!

My Good, with this complaint do not think that I want to do or have what does not please you, no! 53 I am ready to leave it and not enter into it anymore || if that pleases you. I have no other pleasure and I desire nothing other than doing your most holy will and am happy to be able to satisfy even the least of your desires.

This evening, eve of St. Francis of Assisi, before I lay down I promised to this dear Father of mine to do a lengthy discipline until bleeding. 54 He will obtain for me the strength to be able to stand on my feet || tomorrow. The persecutions are many; what pains, my God!

This morning I had the news that another Bishop or Cardinal will die, because in my thanksgiving a person appeared to me who announced to me his death.

But today still nothing. What it left me was affliction.

“Wherever I turn I see darkness that afflicts me”

5 October. Last night at the end of the discipline, I felt worn out by the beating and by the abundant loss of blood. 55 I lay down but I was restless; || it took me long to become calm.

Finally I had a bit of sleep and I was comforted with the hope to sleep for some hours, but all was overturned. I was not yet fully asleep when a shaking woke me up. 56 I saw a black beast as usual, but it had a big head without legs, a twisted, that is, folded tail and it was very busy; later it fell down very badly. I remained || very restless; I felt some kind of fear within me but what could I think? Everything that I felt within me was dark.

Even today I had to leave my dear cell and go away where the weather would allow me to breathe. Oh, this is a real mystery! After only two days I had to leave. What pain for me! 57 The more I go thinking || of what the cause could be, the more I fail to understand. I have a restlessness within me which brings me a general indisposition. I suffer much on all sides, wherever I turn there is a darkness that afflicts me and I do not know the reason.

I saw other deaths of people affectionate to the Institute. They all had to pass by me, good and bad; the same is for the Daughters of St. Anne. I have the notice of the death and then of the passing away. What do these visits bring to me?

58 Oh I feel that this || miserable humanity, the more it becomes old, the more it feels the effects and it is always anxious. I would like to describe something of what I feel but things are so interwoven that I am unable. Wherever I go this state follows me and always with new sufferings. I can never say that the sufferings resemble one another. Even what it produces in me is different each time and I am alone. 59 By now

I am || resigned for I see well that my God wants me this way.

If he gives me a guide little by little it becomes for me as if he were not there and even this is added. What should I say?

Very wise creatures, very holy, they listen to me and say:

  • I am not able to give a judgment.

They only assure me that I walk well, that I must be calm, that it is the work of God; they exhort me not to be disturbed, || they give me many other assurances and then…13

60 Everything is willed by God and I must let it be and live only with the pure confession of my imperfections. Oh, what a pain, my Love!

Notice of people who die.

Superiors who perform badly their duties

6 October. This morning I had a thanksgiving after Holy

Communion which I could equal to all the pains combined into one. I cannot say what unrest for certain words that I seemed to hear. 61 In the afternoon my union with God was different || and while I was concentrating there was a head but I was not able to see the face and it was with a miter and then a minister Cps… Then a friar with beautiful black eyes that looked at me. Still another whom I was not able to distinguish and this had tender eyes and he turned them. Who could it be?

I was able to understand nothing, but from the impression they left me they were 62 not people who belonged to me. However, today I see well that a || new struggle is coming close to me.

My God, how will I bear it if you do not increase my strength with yours! Oh, with this I will be able to bear and overcome! Oh, my sweet Love, you are everything and I am nothing and even less than nothing. How much suffering and tribulations I feel! Give me strength, my Good, my all!

The miter, the skull with miter: here is the poor Monsignor Bianchi! 63 In this way I had already seen. || It is a real martyrdom; new tribulations come on all sides. The only notice that those give me keeps me oppressed.

A big light announced to me the departure of a sister; certainly a superior from this miserable world.

64 Oh, if these sisters who are superiors could see that their star is always bigger than that of the other sisters they would certainly try to do much good and to be observant. In this way they could never be || removed from such an office and they would be the beloved of the Holy Mother and our consolation. How bad I feel when a superior does not carry well her duty; does not bother about the observance and does not care for the sisters. Moreover she makes of the house a secular dwelling; her ruin is certain with the loss of her vocation. In this way she drags with her many poor sisters; it is something || terrible and painful only thinking of it.

“On all sides I find nothing other than pains”

65 9 October. The melancholy is such that I feel a strong headache… I try to distract myself but it is no of use; on all sides I find nothing other than pains and a strong irritation threatens to overcome me. I understand well that this is the oppressed humanity that suffers much and not finding any kind of relief, it twists.

66 It seems it does not want to come out of this painful state of || violence. But not! I had always won and I hope with the help of my God I will overcome. Though I have much anxiety I hope to be always victorious; I also confess that this is a painful struggle and I must suffer much.

“What a pain, my God, to see myself without direction!”

15 October. As I started this book by the will of God I must also finish it.

Oh, how many beasts yesterday and the day before yesterday! 67 Dead persons who always came to visit me, announcing their sorrowful || departure as that one which I saw confusedly. There was a Bishop, my Protector and his secretary. I was so dismayed, because it seemed to me the Bishop would die and not the Protector. Finally it was a terrible struggle. I saw a small devil but at the sight of the Protector it melted into pieces.

What a pain, my God, to see myself without a director!

68 Unfortunately || I do not resist anymore; in these days I experienced a terrible aridity; while I tried to capture a beam of light, there was deep darkness. There was torment on all sides. My side pained much for repressing certain movements or rather snatches. In that moment I repressed for fear of fainting…

End of the painful writing.

15 October 1889.

MS 11. 2 – pp. 1-17

A kiss of the supreme Good as a sign that the soul is not stained

Memoirs of the year 1889: 8 December, day of the Immaculate.

1 I was very sorrowful because the thought of having unwillingly displeased my Good tormented me. This thought had possessed my mind in such a way that it tormented me horribly. My Love, how did I disgust you? Is it true that I committed such an imperfection?

Immediately the monster added:

  • Still worse, it is a real fault.

I was afflicted and it was so much that I started weeping. My God, what did I do? Therefore, there will be no peace at all for me?

In this way I continued for more than an hour. 2 Finally I heard a voice that || said to me:

  • Be calm, there is nothing.

But I was still unsatisfied. The Venerable was exposed and I was to behave in a way that the sisters may not notice my weeping.

My Love be calm! Have pity on me! Let me see if it is true that my soul is stained and that you do not want to see it anymore!

Oh, after a long prayer, my Good showed me my soul. What a delight I felt when my Redeemer gave it a kiss, took it in his arms and caressed it! Everything vanished and I remained calm.

3 Another sign || that he gave me was that the ugly enemy of hell was unmasked and I was able to see clearly that it was really a diabolic suggestion.

I continued to pray especially for some sick; I was anxious to be comforted by Jesus and I had the response that I would receive all the graces.

MS 11. 2 – pp. 17-397

MS 11. 3 – pp. 1-12

Mother Rosa started a new bulky notebook of almost four-hundred pages on December 8 while she was visiting the houses in Sicily. She continued the visit for the whole month of January 1890 until she heard a voice that ordered her: “Away from Sicily, go to the continent.” She continued to write her intimate diary with much regularity until August 29, when she finished filling the notebook; she then paused until November 10, a day on which she started a new exercise book.

The experience of God and of the things of God became always more serene and more purified from human support; she feels a “profound emptiness” and “groping” to meet the Love. It was also a period of external struggles; the Foundress received threats from the masons, while within the Institute the unfaithfulness of some sisters regarding their commitments brought her many problems. On the other hand the problem of her spiritual direction continued without any solution.

The Holy Week of that year had particular importance with an intense program of penance to feel closer to the suffering Christ.

Under the guidance of Jesus she sees that the Institute was ever more strengthened, firmly built on a rock just like that of the Church. All the same it must be noted that there is a shift in her personal way of guiding the Work of God; by now she was not anguished in facing difficulties, but faces them serenely, almost with indifference; that is what the supreme Good wants. She offers herself as a victim to God for his Work.

She discovered the secret of the miraculous power; she became convinced that every sickness was the effect of diabolic installation; the healing came about by commanding the devil who is the cause of the sickness.

On the last three days of June she makes an extraordinary retreat, “in the desert with the supreme Good.” In that recollection her attention was turned to the mystery hidden in her heart, but without revealing it: the change of hearts. At the end of the 17 retreat she renewed the offering of herself and her desire to suffer: “I would like to live a hundred years only to suffer.”

She does not consider it incompatible the giving of herself to the Institute with the attentions for her natural family: she always hoped for the conversion of her brother Federico, she was concerned about her son, Alessandro, sick with tuberculosis, about Carlotta and about her family.

The years and the ailments and, still more, the penances weakened her body, but her spirit is more and more strong.

Experience she had on Christmas octave

1 January 1890. While I meditated in my mind I tried to go again to the manger and I crouched on the ground near the Blessed Virgin and I tried to be close to the feet of Jesus. Soon, I saw myself next to the Blessed Virgin and confused I did not have words at that moment. Oh, happiness!

The dear Child opened his arms to come to me and to embrace me. I cannot say what my happiness was; I would have needed a minute more to tell him at least: - I love you – but I was confused and the sight ceased immediately.

18 I was comforted but very sorrowful because the dear Child || showed me his heart wounded by my faults. Oh, many times I might have been the cause and perhaps I alone would have been enough to wound him so much; I must say that after this sight I was annihilated; I always thought about what I saw, to the thousand protestations and words of affection. Oh, I would destroy myself, if I could be able to remove many faults! My Love, how can one have such a manner of proceeding!

Oh, how can I do? 19 I had much pain in the breast and it was something painful; it seemed as if a rib had been removed || because it was so fixed and I did not know how to stand. At noon it ceased. I thought that it was caused by my weakness but certainly it was something else. While eating it seemed to cease, but still now it seems to me to have received a fist. Oh, that dear heart will suffer! My Good, to me your pains, my sweet Love! My suffering is much.

In me the clarity of hidden things always increases. I find

29 I have much light in everything I must do and decide. My certainty of overcoming everything is such that nothing scares me about having in everything the beautiful victory.

The unrest that this humanity suffers is not out of fear of losing and not coming out of the terrible struggle, no.

59 On every side where I turned my head there was pain and a new sensibility; what a work! I thought || it was the beast that I saw that left me such a pain; but the pain which I was experiencing did not allow me to reason. Certainly, even that beast might have not allowed me to reason, confusing the ideas and assuring me that it was a new very painful illness;

60 truly it was.

As I turned in the bed and tried to have relief, I saw many stars of sisters first one and then another and also of laity;

faces of veiled men || whom I was unable to distinguish but I felt pain. A hand was spread towards me and it was of a dying person asking for help and in this way the pain and the unrest increased in me. At the end it seemed the passage…

A threatening letter of a freemason

12 February. What that monster so horribly had indicated to me about the one who had the miter became true. 61 Oh, I think it might be in feast because it was able to whisper very well to that very good prelate letting him see what has never been. As for his having || been informed badly, everything he saw was bad; it did not work. He would turn even the bricks of the house!

Oh, I will never forget 10 February 1890! How much I suffered! Such a terrible illness overwhelmed me at night that I thought I was dying because I saw clearly the diabolic work. 62 The enemy of peace tried to spoil everything; it was visible M. was not the one making the observations and certainly if there was not that impulse, he would have done

|| otherwise.2

Let the Work be in the hands of its Maker! My God! No one can do anything against your Eternal Father.

When that devil will have become well entangled, the hand of God Almighty will certainly catch him and it will remain in his chain. How the Work of the Lord enrages the terrible monster! Every time a house is opened it roars. How angry it is with me! One has to see what it promises me!

In a letter a head of the freemasons wrote to me in these words: “Finish once and for all and retire! || 63 Ask me whatever you want and you will be satisfied. There will not be happiness that you will miss; finish making victims among the youth! Now it is enough!” At the end it could be read how the devil roared. A second time it threatened me that if I did not finish, I had to be careful…

Oh, how filthy is the kingdom of the whole world! I would not exchange it with the sufferings and tribulations that I meet in the Institute, especially when they come from the people of the || Church; how painful they are! 64 And always when new houses are opened or there is clothing, how the tribulations come out and from the pious one hears:

  • Why do you open new houses? You must stop!

The enemy would like to stop the expansion of the Institute

Oh, what a pain I feel to hear this! 65 Because my thought soon goes to the diabolic act, to the enemy that roars and does not allow that these people with me rejoice thinking that other sisters go sowing || good example in a country. And in certain countries the Christian doctrine is hardly taught anymore if the sisters are not there to teach doctrine in the church and in the school! Oh, what a commotion to see from the smallest to the oldest all turn to the church to hear the sister who teaches and explains catechism! How many facts if we kept in memory! 66 Therefore, one need not desire to fill the whole world and that all may become || religious while there are infinite numbers of these unfortunate… Oh, my Love!

The desire of converting all and teaching all to love you and that the whole world may become Catholic, Apostolic and Roman is strong.

67 Oh, though without strength, how I would run so that all may learn and when I am able to accept a house in these small villages, what a consolation I feel though I know it will be a new cross. In the thought that they will give glory to God, the weight of the cross becomes sweet || and I embrace it to my breast, sweet pledge of my Love. Certainly the nature has to give vent; it twists and must struggle with the enemy that becomes strong in whispering:

  • Leave - it starts telling me – once and for all, think that you are weak and you cannot resist anymore many toils; take your rest and do not have much suffering. Furthermore you have them all against you!

68 And it continues as it finds something to seize on || to torment me. Finally its subtleness is so made that nothing would prevent my remaining convinced but the voice of my Lord is very different, encouraging me clearly to go ahead, that he will always be with me and if sometimes for an instant

I said:

  • I do not want to do anything anymore, I will act slowly;

– what reproaches I received!

69 How I was fully crouched in one corner to ask for pity, mercy and forgiveness and offer myself as a victim, that is to renew my || promises, that until the last breath I will be for his Institute and always a victim of expiation for him!

Oh, my sweet good, how this ass would soon adapt itself to think only for itself and delight in a bit of calm but it will never happen. Yes, with your help the enemy will never win and I will always live oppressed as you wish, my God!

“My Good, I call for you and weeping I search for you everywhere, but everything is dark”

16 February 1890.

70 A very fierce beast threatened to crush me; it left me so sick that I was unable to stand on my feet. || That was not enough, another small one distressed me horribly and I did not know its meaning because the signs it had were confused. Furthermore it was restless moving here and there, pain of a certain… I do not know how to explain. It was made in a certain way; it is easier for me to explain what it left me than how it was. I would only say that my poor head was confused and interiorly I was restless, presage of a painful event; now I am feeling a smell of a dead person and finally much pain.

71 Oh, my Love || let at least this pain take away whatever the poor Institute must be subjected to. Certainly most of the cause would be given to my wickedness. Oh, my God have pity on me! I am always so much oppressed and with an emptiness within my soul that I am unable to define it. I am always alone. My Good, I call upon you and weeping I search for you everywhere, but everything is dark. I say everywhere because in everything that I say and do I try to identify with your most holy will but I do not know how to resist.

Anguish for the attitude of the confessor

72 There are moments in which || I would rather weep, especially when I hear being read a life about the help the good souls received from their directors. Oh, what a torture I feel, my God! It is something very painful and I repeat it, because in this way I go on saying to the confessor very often that I am anguished seeing myself deprived of direction. What does he answer?

  • Be calm, go ahead, and do not doubt that you will go well!

When I want to give him a hint of my penances he says:

  • Do them! ||

73 He approves everything without listening to me. There are moments in which I accuse my horrible state or rather I want to accuse; not at all! He interrupts and answers:

  • Calm, and do whatever God suggests to you.

I fear and I say:

  • I might hurt myself!

  • No, you won’t! He answers; he almost imposes silence on me not wishing to hear me.

What should I do? Will it be always like this? In the midst of much suffering and of every kind of tribulations not to have someone to whom to say a word is truly painful! ||

74 19 February. What the devil did to me last night! It was something sorrowful and painful. At night it gave me notice

– I can say this – of all that would happen the following day.

Tired at night, the following day I passed to the facts:

discussion of families that belong to me, a chaos of various pains that I seemed to succumb to.

75 But I was resigned in bearing them for I saw clearly that it was not I who was listening calmly and before I answered

I reflected; my Good suggested to me what I should say.

The suffering was much || such that with a strong impulse of love and certainty of being granted, I threw myself at the feet of my Crucifix.

  • Do you see what this does? Defend me, put an end…

He assured me that I would have everything that I desired and he would take care of everything. I opened the door again and I spoke peacefully. Today I had proof that he will take care of everything…

76 I had confession with my director; I told him that I was not well spiritually and asked if I should remain always like this and do what || I think. In fact he had told me that I could do that and he would give obedience to everything.

But how? What manner is this?

  • God wants it, go ahead – I was answered.

What kind of path is this?

My Love, how can I walk without a guide who indicates precisely the way?

How happy those souls must have been! 77 When I experienced it for a few months I seemed to be in another world. Everything was sweet || but it disappeared quickly and… I was always alone! Oh, how arid it is… Only suffering is a guide and a shield but no comfort can be received.3 I understand the gain that my soul gets but I also feel the thorns since many prick me horribly without my having someone to relieve me of the pain of the wound. I had to do everything but I must treat and repair things myself. But sometimes I feel interiorly unhappy and || that saddens me. 78 But always no one realizes.

I would like to have a word from my Good; instead I do not feel him. Everything is dark. I see that the affairs of his Work are becoming easier to accomplish and I understand that he is the one who carries and disposes everything. But I cannot keep quiet since that I feel some certainty of doing the will of my good; it is only himself who works. Oh, how sweet is doing your holy will, my God! ||

79 I cannot understand how a person can live without knowing God, the supreme Good!

Worry for the fidelity of the sisters to the life they have embraced

21 February. After that bit of lament I made with the director, I was not disturbed anymore; but I had peace and today I see with clarity my journey, the path that pleases my God.

He clearly taught me about what he did with me, that I was not alone; others would have come in the future not completely alone, but less tied. I would have liked that even they would have a similar path. || 80 After he showed me many and very frightening events that only remembering them again I feel a dread and pain.

To see how the devil is very capable of invading the minds and the very good ones possessed by certain ideas never yield and they fall without willing to be persuaded. They do not give up what they are fixed on and the wrong manner of thinking, and they are reduced to a regrettable condition. How fierce they became! 81 I see it in the poor || sisters that, taken by such an animal, they lose their mind.

One can try to make them reason making them touch with their hand their perdition. No, they even become more obstinate and there is no way of moving them; then I truly suffer! I see clearly that beast that keeps them bound and they cannot find a means that can show them by whom they are fascinated: nothing helps reach this aim.

82 Once I felt very sad for the sight of what || I saw; I mean of the monster of the enemy. I cried loudly:

  • You are damned, and you are at the edge of hell if you leave the habit! Yes, I repeated to her.

But nothing could move her. My God, after some time what a death she had! And how much she suffered in a bed in the hospital.

There are many souls of that type and how can one not feel failing from the pain? A soul that has been graced and privileged with the holy vocation and so terribly hounded by that monster!

83 My Love, if I could || become a victim for all these poor souls and in this way they could remain freed of such a horrible monster! If my discipline and the penances could obtain for the Daughters of St. Anne to be all freed from such a terrible invasion and in all the houses could reign the holy observance. In this way all these creatures could please you truly. Oh, when I think I would like all to be according to your heart, my Love! 84 Dear blessed Virgin, St. Anne my Mother, || may I obtain everything from my God through you.

“I feel emptiness in my soul. Everything for me is nothing other than a play of the time that passes”

23 February 1890. I can say that the same state of tribulations continues; my soul is afflicted in such a way that nothing helps to relieve me in a labyrinth of tribulations. I continually see a spirit that oppresses me and I feel a painful action without being able to say I will come out, if I can remove this or that other.

85 Everything comes from the unrest of the Work; the tribulations are always new, but not, because it seems me I am used to them. || I do not think that these oppress me, no; I am used to carry them at the feet of my God that he may do with them what pleases him. If he wishes to end them, he is the master to put an end; if he wishes they continue, let him do it for I am always happy suffering something for him but I feel that they do not give me pain anymore as they did before. For the other sufferings of the family, I feel them but then once I entrusted them to my Good, I do nothing but I pray and with this I feel I have everything.

86 But this is a || tribulation of its own: I feel emptiness in my soul. Everything for me is nothing other than a play of time that passes, without understanding if this time had been used according to what my God wishes. But not even this is the sorrowful side of the emptiness that is in my soul. Prayer has no more strength for me in order to feel even partially a very small drop enter into that great emptiness; no, I see it always the same, it oppresses me and I weep. I would like to know from my Good why my soul || is reduced to this point. What should I do? Penances? 87 Oh, the chain that enters now on one side and then on the other that is always inside the flesh, and in the evening many times when I move, I find it painful and I feel faint. In the same way my usual pains in the hands and in the feet and the side… Oh, my Love, many times it seems I am about to die! 88 What I suffer at night; how can I describe, without narrating the variety of the pains beyond the usual || of my side. If I turn on the side of the liver, there is the physical sickness that I carry and woe betide me if I bump the side! What pains! And then the variety according to which the monsters that move around pass; the visit of people, but that is not enough. All the discipline until bleeding and all the pains together are nothing in comparison with what I suffer in the emptiness of my soul.

Only you my Good can fill it and in this way put an end to this terrible suffering.

89 I throw myself at his feet and with all the strength || of the suffering I say to him: My Love, have pity of my soul!

Take me out of such painful martyrdom.

Envy of the souls who have a guide who comforts them

Oh, how happy are those souls who exposing this state to their guide, are relieved, instructed and comforted by his teaching though they have to experience again such pain;

but the material comfort is much, it makes light of the suffering but this ass is alone. 90 While I write I weep, I cannot do otherwise, abandoned in this way in a vast field where there is || every kind of cultivation, alas! And I am very upset by terrible pains. I cannot say that my Good has abandoned me because I am able to contemplate very well.

I stay motionless even for one hour contemplating the suffering of a wound of my dear Crucifix; I remain and every now and then I feel union with him, but what a pain…

Nothing of this takes root in my soul and I see clearly…

91 For this clarity I feel a strong pain and where can I find a help? Oh, blessed souls || you who have received much consolation from your direction, why don’t you obtain for me comfort and relief!

My Good, when will you give me understanding on this painful state and instruct me?

Starving, as the deer thirsting seeks for water to quench itself, how many prayers and supplications I offer to the Eternal Father, so that he may take me out of this painful state! 92 A small light seemed to me to see that could lose || the darkness and let me see how it was, what it meant and the reason of the sight, if the soul had no advantage at all in that state.

Oh, how my mind was confused! Only at the thought that I reduced it in such a heathen state I felt tearing my breast with pain. How can it be? Will there be no peace for me? Oh, indescribable pains!

Only you, my Love, can know how much a soul could suffer in such a state! 93 I see and feel something of an event on the || earth; without seeing anything clearly, it terrifies me…

Foreboding the destruction of a city

27 February. At quarter past three I woke up as if it was the waking hour; after twenty minutes there was a swarm of beasts which in the form of bricklayers threw down the houses and the big stones and in an instant they destroyed them; at the end it was an immense destruction. Immediately I was frightened; how can it be! This is a notice of a city that will be destroyed in less than a quarter of an hour. 94 I can say that it was a flash that || absorbed and destroyed. The fear ceased or rather the fright but I felt something to see how in the room they were able to form a real picture, so big as if it was where the disaster would take place. How could I describe the shape in which they were made and the bigness of the stones! Finally I am not able to make the description.

Much weakness and tiredness

How I was worn out for not being able to take anymore than half an hour of sleep, I was so tired! 95 In this way today with the work I had my poor head suffered so much that a pain || took me. But the emptiness I felt was more painful as if there was nothing inside the skull. Oh, how painful this action! Only to lock myself and keep silence and let everything come to still… and alone without thinking of anything. In this way slowly it seems to be filled and regains strength to be able to think, but I cannot occupy myself seriously, otherwise it goes back.

96 This brain is consumed for you, my God and when I think, I console myself || at the thought that it has been consumed for you, my Good.

Oh, it is only this thought that gives me strength to do again the work as soon as I regain the strength!

The struggle that I must sustain many times when I am like this… The ugly monster how many times comes to whisper to me! The pains are without compare but I can say that this happens rarely, because perhaps now that the weakness is much I might faint. That is why my Good does not allow it. 97 It seems to me that very worn out as I am, everything || increases the pain that is indescribable.

Those people usually come before they die or if they must do evil to me continue to pass. This one who came many times is a Cardinal with hair all tied and a long and wide face. His long thick hair comes a bit to the front, it covers his ears; he was serious.

I asked if there was a Cardinal with such hair. 98 They said yes and they also named him, but I do not remember the name. || I will see what will happen. If I had to write of all those who pass it would need much.

“On all sides there is a new tribulation”

1 March. Last night, while exhausted from work I retired in the room, I was so oppressed that I wanted to rest. Having finished all my small things – my Love, I was not able to bear anymore – a convulsion started to upset me! What could it be? But I understood nothing and I prayed. It was worse; it was as if something was to happen to me, something which would make me suffer. 99 The whole night was like this; I had nothing except sufferings but the sights of certain black devils

|| what they left me! I spent part of the night in this way: I also saw small black souls but I felt sorrow for their perdition. I would have liked to do, I do not know what, to save them! It seems odd that I must always write new tribulations that are unbelievable. In this time I am so afflicted and on all sides there is a new tribulation. 100 I feel there is an invisible hand that supports me and this I see clearly. I could not resist but || my

God sustains everything, I understand it.

That emptiness in my soul continued. I do not see any disclosure to make me hope to come out of this state. My

God, have pity on me!

From yesterday the Blessed Virgin is comforting me! Every time I make a prayer and I prostrate under her feet it seems to me that she assures me that the present struggles are ended and less sorrowful days will come. It is well understood: it is to get strength and then other tribulations…

Oh, most Blessed Virgin, what a slow martyrdom is this! I carry on with pleasure and resignation but from you, || my dear Mother, I expect the strength of Jesus!

“I would like to suffer always, my Good, but close to you”

101 5 March. After lunch while I was in the church, my side was gasping so much that if I were not distracted and trying to control myself, I would have certainly fainted. What flames! The whole side seemed to me to be consuming such was the fire that I felt. My Love, why all this suddenly?

102 If I am not deceived I seem to hear that certain acts of resignation and having recovered so well and || done those acts of humility, pleased him. This is why I had that relief which lasted just a little time. I am still in my aridity with that emptiness in my soul which makes me suffer. Now that I feel strengthened a bit it seems to me that my state becomes less heavy and not with that terrible fear which gives me much anguish. Oh, if my Good would wish that it may remain like this without increasing the tribulations!

103 I would like to suffer always my Good, but close to you. A thousand hells || could be nothing if I could remain tightly grasping at your heart but it is very painful not to see you and hear you. I am only ruled by the fear of having disgusted my Good. This is the most horrible pain there could be. I live only for you and I am for you and in you my Love!

The Institute as the Church is solidly built on the stone

11 March 1890. At the end of my thanksgiving at Holy Communion a big devil with white trousers and the legs covered by the same for they were long appeared to me. In its

hands it had a big iron which it sharpened under a very big rectangular stone. 104 It toiled much || but it did not succeed; it always tried more but it achieved nothing, as it was not touched.

Suddenly it left the iron and disappeared. Then I saw my Redeemed standing straight on the same stone and with his hand lifted he said to me:

  • This stone will never be moved.

  • My God, what does it mean, the Institute?

  • No, it is my Church.

  • What about the Institute?

  • It will be the same.

And he disappeared. But for these questions that I made, the consolation that I felt was very much! Oh, my Love, how can what I felt be described!

105 I asked a cure for a sick person, but it was afterwards and he assured me of her healing. || This was an interior voice, as that one of some days ago when I asked for the provincial of Sicily; even then he told me that she would be healed and that was what happened.

In these days I had very terrible persecutions and many more because of certain good religious. Oh, how many they invent! What tongues!

My God thinking that they offend you, how I suffer!

Furthermore to see that those who sin are foolish souls!

Oh, how can I make them known!

106 I well expected it because that monster came || and showed me the evil that would happen but I did not know where and with whom. What could I do? I could only pray and suffer. For six days the suffering has been so much that there were hours in which I seemed not to have life anymore; what pains! The whole body, every side has its pain and all these monsters with different actions move in the room, now here, then there, as usual always with new signals.

107 This night I had again the assurance that with the others he would have his own. What a pain, my Love! ||

Stars of every kind move around, some big that they leave me not very bothered and some small ones; there will be many deaths.

Two of them stayed for more than four hours in the room and they were united; I explain myself: as this sign; they were shining and everywhere I turned they also ran. This gave me much pain.

The same: They certainly died in America, and yet they seemed to me to have something || different.

108 A night of bodily suffering for the Institute

25 March: Day of the Assumption of Mary.

I spent a bad night with a continuous pain as if tired. I slept but even in my sleep if I can call it sleeping I struggled with certain thoughts which wanted to dominate my mind.

Despite making certain efforts I could say I did not rest even a quarter of an hour. In this way every now and then with my eyes open I saw beasts here and there; I always saw them without understanding anything. I do not stop to describe the past days in which I felt very sick. 109 One night while I was very || sick and the two secretaries watched over me a voice said to me:

  • You must suffer these pains so that the Institute will be spared an evil that could come; you will suffer until three. Oh, how that voice consoled me!

  • Yes – I repeated – my Good, I suffer with much pleasure and I feel that I am recovering.

In fact, I was assured; at three the strong pains ceased and I remained calm. I remained alone, I locked myself and I suffered again, but much less and after half an hour I slept. 110 I had nothing || other than an exhaustion that remained for half a day.

I will continue to describe my day which I always spent with the Eternal Father. How well I found myself in meditation!

Oh, fortunate Blessed Virgin, how and what a treasure your breast possessed! Dear Mother, towards you I feel a real and deep veneration.

Deceptions of interior life which some sisters suffer

Last night, while I entrusted a Daughter of St. Anne sick to God and I asked him if she had a certain sickness, he answered:

  • No, she will be healed, be calm.

111 In the same way I had other || graces. While I was speaking with a Daughter of St. Anne and we were alone

–she was a dear soul, really an angel:

  • What happened?

I saw a beautiful array of angels, all the same and in feast.

I understood this was for this dear and beautiful soul.

Oh, my Love, I really feel so ugly and I feel with evidence my meanness, my nothingness. I am not worthy to have such dear creatures!

112 In another sister, who thought to have something || how I clearly see her deception! The pain for not breaking in her the rope that ties is great; if I make her deception clear to others, I would ruin her completely. In this way I think that the lesser evil would be to try to correct her, such that she would walk limping; she does not commit any evil, not even imperfection but helped also by her guide, it is better to leave her to get that partial little bit of good. Certainly she could make much progress.

113 On the other hand they are fearful souls || much attached to themselves, and to their own judgment, guided by their own criteria and this shaped in the manner of feeling, seeing praying, and acting. Everything should be good and right.

Furthermore finding someone who helps them, they always close themselves. 114 Except that these souls are subject to melancholy and many times to irascibility, when the things do not go according to their desires and they take it easily with God, as annoyed. || They let themselves be carried away and here it happens that often times they commit imperfections leaving the prayers or the Holy Communion or the meditation. Even externally one can notice their ill-state and this certainly prevents the perfection, because by doing this many times they end up making it a habit.

115 They restart only when it seems right to them – and they take it for sure – to have seen or felt something divine, and many times it is their illusion and || creation of their fantasy. In this way, what they experience interiorly comes out of their interior disposition, and feeling this, they become electrified, and feel assured. And when melancholy comes to them as I said above, then they are in trouble.

116 Much depends on the guide. If he is wise and holy certainly he soon takes them out of everything and puts them on the straight path making them walk with determination, starting to consolidate them in virtue and in self-denial, removing perfectly from them || any small idea of feeling and seeing… He makes them know that one must go to Jesus with humility and ask to be always least in everything, forming the idea of oneself that one is nothing and less than nothing. As someone, do not say – I am evil and sinful – with the mouth and after if they really find someone who tells them that; how badly they take it!

How difficult is this point to be truly penetrated by our real nothingness and by our incapacity in everything! 117 If a soul really possesses this || it could be said that it really runs on the path of perfection and will make big steps to climb the mountain where the Being of her life is.

How many tribulations, my God! I give a look and I cannot do other than say that without your strength I will know that one could not bear the slander. They are without compare against the poor Institute. If one is frustrated another one comes up; it is truly a fire and there is neither escape nor explanation. My God, your Work was born in the midst of thorns and it became huge in tribulations. || 118 May your divine will be always done.

Night anxieties and other sufferings

1 April 1890. At two after midnight I woke up called by a voice that seemed to be crying; it was so clear but certainly not. A strong convulsion overwhelmed me and there was no way that I could sleep such that I wanted to wake up. While

I lay down I always meditate until half past five. I was feeling tired and faint. While I meditated with a strong restlessness, I felt much fear that the voice could be of someone who belonged to me. 119 I asked my dear Crucifix if that person was sick; || he answered me that she/he was well.

First I asked my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore who told me that the person was not sick at all but was very well. It was very clear but the enemy continued to frighten me such that I felt faint. Oh, how I desired the hour of Holy Communion and of the Mass! I really felt very far. How much I suffered, my God! Today I thought I could not bear it but Jesus provided me with his strength and I was able to work well without any fault.

120 I prayed so that || Jesus would change into years the months in which the Virgin most holy told me that a family where there were sick, for a range of months would have nothing any more and they would be well. Oh, most Blessed

Virgin, not months but years, and always! I also hoped my dear advocate Sister Anne del Salvatore would obtain for me everything.

A painful program for the Holy Week

How I feel in these days! 121 Today, holy Tuesday, a very reassuring voice exhorted me to do the major penances. I already made the commitment to increase as far as I will be able and || to discipline myself until bleeding every evening;

in addition on Thursday and Friday for the whole night I remain on the ground at the feet of my dear Crucifix with iron on my arms and with everything with which I can cover with penances this body and make it suffer.

My ass, it is I who command not you; for Jesus you must suffer everything. How much, my God! I certainly do not give up consuming all my strength. I only regret that I have no more but very little, to be consumed for you.

How much I desire the cell || of Piacenza! 122 Oh, there with much ease I was able to give vent! This evening I feel I have a fever; how much pain I feel!

Tomorrow is Friday and certainly always the same; all the Good Fridays I am in bed because I feel all kinds of pains and I am without strength. I already feel a feverish thirst that burns my feet, my hands and my breast; I cannot explain. The hands are already swollen and I feel strong pains while I write. Oh, my Love, what I feel!

I wanted to write what I felt today and weeping I prayed to the Eternal Father that he may forgive my sins. 123 Oh, how I felt clearly that he was pleased with my || suffering, but I am unable to describe it. I was well aware that it was not me who said such words but they came from an interior impulse and I repeated them. How I could destroy myself by weeping! Tomorrow my food will not be anything more than a little bread and how can it be different!

How much my Good, suffers! My sufferings are really nothing. I finish for I cannot bear anymore.

Retrospective look at the Sacred Triduum

6 April. Easter of Resurrection! I could not describe how much I suffered. Every side of my body had a pain: the hands, the feet. 124 At the belt, I felt a very || strong pain as if a rope moved around tearing the flesh. The burning was so strong that it prostrated me; but I did not add more than what I carry always, no. My head was breaking! The pain of the nail which always keeps me company in these days was very strong, and the swelling on the side of the heart was much. Oh, my Love only you could say what passed in it!

On Friday the fire was so strong that it prostrated me. Oh, how this ass was reduced; it was unable to stand on its feet. 125 I would have liked to do everything to wake up but it was not possible. || The thought that they would say every year I am in bed tormented me. Oh, my Love, they will suspect! Meanwhile the pain increased. I had promised that I would eat only bread. In this way I prayed my Good that if he would give me a bit of strength, towards evening I would have asked my secretary for a bit of bread, for charity’s sake. Having made this promise the pains ceased a bit – it might have been half past three – and I tried to stand up; but what suffering!

126 My God, it was such kind of pain as if || I were always fainting.

I stayed for a while but then I lay down, and I did what I promised: for charity’s sake to ask the secretary for some bread. The dear creature with much affection and promptness after begging me to take some soup agreed to give me what I asked for. I also did the discipline until bleeding but this time many things like the iron on the arms caused me fever which frightened me for sometime.

127 Later || I removed them and I disciplined myself lightly seeing I had no more blood: some small pieces of flesh and clear blood came out which impressed me. On the other hand with satisfaction I said to my Good: this has all been consumed for you and makes me hope for the forgiveness of my enormous sins. 128 At the feet of my dear Crucifix I wept much at the thought that he suffered much for me. Oh, || how much I wept!

In this way my stomach, the sick bones, what did they feel? Much pain! I would have liked to hear a word from my Good, but nothing; pure suffering without the minimum comfort and for two nights again I saw signs of an epidemic as those which I saw with the flue. In some places it was less serious while in others it was more, but spread all over the world. It was not in a triangular way but all in disconnected lines and very grey. 129 In the same way beasts in great quantity, small, naked devils || that scrambled on the windows, all kinds of big and small monsters; they made me fear that something would happen to certain people. Immediately I was asking and I was given a negative answer.

Finally on Easter day peacefully I came down to the private chapel to hear the Mass; this was at consecration. 130 I saw a young friar with an angelic aspect as if he entered by the gate which leads to the main altar. || He crossed and went to the choir but before entering he disappeared. He was without mantle, thin and white in face. How he surprised me! Who could he be? I do not remember having seen him. He left me something of paradise; all my fears of being always the most disgraceful creature disappeared and I did not weep anymore. On Holy Saturday after receiving Holy Communion, how much I wept! 131 While I was with my Good and I made the gift of myself to the Eternal Father, I released much; || and in my mind I was very united with my Good. I always had something that made me feel interiorly a kind of fear.

New effects that the tribulations leave now

In these three days I was comforted with a grace that I asked for and I desired a response: I received it, that the time will be prolonged and certain people would not even come. And then the certainty of my conscience: I seemed to hear clearly interiorly that they were scarecrows and everything was said and well confessed.

132 Even for certain || things on the Rules I received such clear answers that every doubt disappeared. In addition my Good caused a wise person to come and I believe with certainty even the holy Cardinal Protector comforted me for certain fears and assured me there was nothing wrong.

This was very good to my poor head that even this benefited and until now I feel the effects. Oh, my God, bless him! I set a prayer for him every morning.4

133 I do not speak of || the tribulations of these days which were many but I had the certainty that the victory could have been very beautiful.

Many times I released with this ass which felt it much. I do not understand what effects the tribulations have on me now; they are new for me because these for now are nothing in comparison to the past. Now I feel so bad and they depress me and I would not be happy. 134 I feel a displeasure against myself and I || do not know what to do. Nothing is able to persuade me. I am resigned and calm but I feel an effect or rather a strong action on my body that I am upset. I reproach this ass and I try to punish it – though I am sure that it is completely dead – With pain I try to make it experience an additional tightening with the chain that I carry, but it is useless.

Why do – I go begging – while I am sure of the victory I feel so much? 135 I believe that it is a pain that my Good || deigned to add; pure unrest.

A black brooch in the wound of the side of Jesus

10 April 1890. I was more convinced that only from my

God I could have comfort and I have put only in him all my smallest actions.

When fears come up even those people who come close remain perplexed, as if there was something ambiguous and it pains me.

It has no other use than increasing the pain; many times

136 I am persuaded that the creatures are like this, that when faced with fears everyone shrugs his/her shoulders; they do not say a word, because || they are not convinced of what is said. But my Good, who in his infinite charity never gives up helping the oppressed, soon gives the means through which light becomes clear and comes to shine on the dull minds and in this way one is persuaded of the voice of the one who wisely governs us.

Oh, for me blessed is such a superior who with much charity knows how to give the true and right council in everything. 137 Then immediately they change their aspect and in their || hearts everything remains smiling.

I am also bombarded by thoughts that even though foolish, annoy me.

I want to explain how I am in prayer and meditation.

Today there was a moment in which I suffered much because I paused on the wound of the side. Oh, pain! I was so concentrated and my mind was fully there; while I was absorbed I saw a big black brooch, as the one we have and which passed from one side to the other of the wound taking the two sides together.

138 My Love || - I said – interiorly everything is understood! Give me that big brooch; let it all enter into my breast, and not in yours! I am the disgraceful one who put it on you!

An interior voice replied to me:

  • No, I did all I could that it came to me.

It left my Love and it was as if I felt it. But who could it be? What could it be? Certainly I did not delay to know it; the certainty that soon it will be explained is such that I do not worry anymore and I seem to be less anxious to have news and to know. 139 No, nothing bothers me. I have no relief than to stay with my || God averse from every thing that belongs to this earth.

There are tribulations and I try to bear them with patience and resignation. In my Good I release everything and I tell him everything that I receive.

  • Leave the pains for me – I tell him – you take care of your Work that needs to be defended.

Therefore, he will take care and I am his slave who badly carries on her back the burden which he wants me to carry.

Strong melancholy and continuous weeping

14 April 1890. My God, I would have done nothing other than weeping! || 140 the melancholy resulted from the continuous afflictions that the humanity can bear no more. I wept but I tried not to be noticed; everything annoyed me because everything increased my pain without being able to say a word. I have no creature that can understand me; where can I go, to whom and with whom?

Only to you, my Good! But have even you abandoned me in this sorrowful state? 141 To see me suspected of betraying the interests of the Institute to which I gave everything! || Oh, what I feel, my Love!
