I am under a terrible temptation: to make in a way that I may be removed from this office and do the beggar, the nurse, the lowly duties, but not this one.5

I hear a voice that says:

  • It is not yet time, my Work requires it!

Oh, so many tribulations! Oh, what a cruel pain to see people that make use of every one!

My son, even himself poor, under such cruel suffering and yet he should not…

142 Oh, what I felt today, to see him go away || after having an abscess with a strong fever. He suffered so much! I am a tyrant, my Love!

Most Holy Virgin, you who have been a Mother, look to my suffering and take care!6

I cannot give up: as I write I weep, I feel my breast breaking from pain. How can I show myself; I am so crushed by weeping!

While I prayed and the weeping had ceased a bit, suddenly I saw a cart with many saddle-clothes and at the top there was seated a woman with a crown but I was not able to distinguish well. 143 There was a multitude of men who pulled the cart. Finally || I saw a shoulder-belt that the woman was carrying, where was written: Republic.7 She had her two hands spread and she held herself on two projecting trimmed woods; it gave me the effect of someone in rags. It vanished and it left me with the impression of unrest, I was restless. My pain restarted; in this way everything ended and only weeping was my comfort.

It costs me much to hide my suffering; unfortunately I realize that they suspect and I am a cause of displeasure for my dear secretaries. 144 I try to assure them || that I have nothing, and since I have a headache, I do not know how I can be lively because this oppresses me; being so weak it dominates the whole body and I remain upset.

It was true that I had a strong headache and it oppressed me but it was caused by the weeping: every time that I weep the pain starts strongly and continues for some days.

I am always with my Good and I release my pain at his feet. 145 I feel the || certainty that he will take care of everything.

“I sensibly see a hand that guides me and acts in the Work of the Lord”

28 April 1890. They are right to tell me that they do not understand or I do not understand because I have no other than one director and it is as if I do not have him. I do not understand myself: a volcano of stuff that I cannot explain. I seem like a tree shaken by winds because now here, then there I am shaken on all sides. I do not know what to think or say: I do not even distinguish what it is and the meaning.

146 I saw another very big sign of an epidemic; very fierce beasts that left me shaken || and black souls, poor for whom I felt pity. I do not know who they are, but I always fear that there may be someone who belongs to me.

But even if that was not the case, I felt much pain. It seems to me that I feel the courage to go to that unfortunate person to whom the soul belongs and tell her/him that I really feel pity.

Last evening while I was in my study room I saw a very big person completely wrapped with black.

Without being able to know anything he/she disappeared. Who could it be? 147 The person remained always in my mind for a long time and many times || I remember her/him. My God, did the person die or will he/she die? Nothing. This left me with pain.

I am so confused that I try all I can to be released, but I am not able and I feel bad in this state of suffering which I do not know how to describe. I sensibly see a hand that guides me and acts in the Work of the Lord. 148 And yet with all this, I suffer much because there are things in me, of my poor spirit which make me groan much and I suffer with resignation yes, but I toil || much so that they may not notice.

They all believe that it is the effect of my bad health; the sorrow is seen even on the face but it cannot be compared to what I suffer. The pains and sufferings of physical sickness in comparison to what I suffer interiorly, all the pains that I suffered and I suffer physically are nothing in comparison to my interior pains.

My Beloved, how much I suffer when I do not feel you and not even hear your voice! 149 All, all is dark. I move gropingly in this || horrible desert of my intellect which has nothing that can comfort me.

I feel arid, dry, thirsty and hungry; I find nothing that could save me, pity my God! Oh, how my infamy had reduced me! My side, even this is a cause of a strong thought.

Oh, mercy!

Healing of a sister for an order to a devil responsible for the sickness

What I suffered at the sight of a failure that a Daughter of

St. Anne committed, because that is how they are always represented! 150 From three after midnight it was so terrible that || I was not able to sleep.

Oh, where could it be! I clearly saw where the monster had reached. I suffered so much that in the morning I found myself full of pain such that I was not able to stand on my feet and as if the nerves retired I was not only limping but bent and staggering. I laughed alone to see myself reduced that way; I dressed myself with difficulty and went to the church but every movement was spasmodic. 151 I laughed at myself, but those strong pains lasted until this morning. ||

The spasm has now left me and I can walk straight; I still feel pain but it is light. If with that I could prevent the monster from causing much evil! I feel cold only thinking of it; how ugly the filthy Satan!

Yes, from the letters that I received yesterday while I was under those pains, as I opened one letter, I found that a good sister was warning me. I hope that my dear Jesus did not allow the monster to succeed in what it wanted to do. ||

152 The thought that what I suffer can avoid sins comforts me; suffering is sweet, but I am not good for anything else because as your slave, my Love, Beloved of my soul, I am an abject creature and have no capacity.

Something horrible, a very bad sickness, that ugly monster wanted to provoke and even tried to cause it through a drug; it could be said that it achieved and in that sister a terrible sickness was already starting. ||

153 My Good showed me clearly everything which has already taken place in that sister and a sickness of such magnitude was formed…

An interior voice suggested to me…

  • With a command in God’s name drive away from her the monster.

I did not delay to put into execution what I heard and the monster left soon. It is said that there are many of these sicknesses but during my youth many operations were never seen. Here is from whom they are produced. Oh, how can || I make these people who do not believe understand? 154 And everything comes from… Before people turned to God and to the most holy Virgin but…

How bad I feel! And yet there are no means. Many times I asked my Good that he may open a way in order to make them know their blindness; I had nothing. Only that in my mind confusion is formed and seems to me everything is as a heap of many events and of these nobody understands anything. 155 But the same || are instruments of damnation to themselves. They feel nothing and give a stable thought to their material existence only; everything is momentary from their short present time and they do not bother about the future, because the one who leads them is Satan. This has not any kind of stability, only destruction of good. In what unrest one lives in!

I feel near the end of this state of things, and yet I have some kind of a strong fear of the nearing of a punishment which will upset everything. Oh, terrible moment!

156 While I write I feel a strong restlessness because a terrible spectacle || comes clearly before me.

My Love, have pity on your brides and on my children!

You have always cared for them, I do not doubt; have compassion on the nature that is restless, but my spirit is full of energy, confidence, and certainty in you, my Good, of being assisted by you in everything.8

Violent manifestations on the occasion of 1st May

1st May. Here is what I saw of turmoil today and everything is explained. 157 They came here just near us to pick up stones to throw at the soldiers; furthermore the unrest of the people continued. || What terrible moments! How could one be calm, my God, to see the whole world in revolution, just as I saw it! My God have pity on us!9

On the ceiling colored signs appeared to me; six coals burning with red flames and they left me much unrest. I was hearing continuous shouting in my ears, as if there were people that shouted strongly: I was not able to sleep and I passed the whole night like this.

Oh, how tired I feel! During the day I am a rag! 158 On all sides an obstacle || to work in the vineyard of the Lord;

everything gives me much pain. I see the work and I cannot finish it; my pains afflict me very much and I would not like more than to be conformed to what my Good sends me. I am even unable to do this. In this way as I suffer all kinds of pains, it is nothing; I am resigned and in peace, I would even say, with pleasure. But not to meet my Good, not to hear him, not to understand where I am and why I am this way, what a || terrible thing! 159 There are no expressions that can express what this pain is and on this side I do not reason anymore: I see it, the suffering is much.

Lively compassion for the fate of the sinners

3 May, This morning, while I was meditating, I found myself enraptured by my Good and what sweetness of love invaded me! 160 In my Good I kept my intellect and I saw a big burden of very white objects and in the ecstasy as if it was taken away from me || to a sure place, but I did not understand where it was! My Love, how can I describe it!

In this way the whole day I remained in my God and with much resignation. Everything was sweet and easy to bear; the same was for prayer. That union remained always in me and gave me strength to bear with pleasure the crosses; all the suffering became so light that it is no longer suffering but it is sweet.

Today is the Exaltation of the Cross,10 this treasure, that I love most because on it my Good || breathed his last.

161 Oh, most Holy Virgin, consume me in your love and in that of Jesus.

And the poor sinners? Oh, how much pain I feel when I think and for what will happen! This thought is terrible: to see the evil and not to be able to persuade them to give it up. If only I were able to make them understand that he is God, the supreme Good and that true happiness is found only in him, in this life of bitterness and more than anything else in eternity. Oh, pains, oh, happiness.

162 Poor souls, how could I fail to faint || with these reflections? If they knew you, my Love, the fear of eternity could convert all in order to have the fortune to be with you, to be able to see your face unveiled and rejoice in you who are every sweetness and beatitude!

Therefore, always deprived of your presence, poor souls!

My Love how can you make them understand this? 163 To see them, the pain I feel is such that I feel a twisting of nerves and I always go on || thinking how I could be able to convert them though I understand I am a useless instrument and good for nothing. I still have much desire and anxiety that consumes me and disturbs me and the will to be able to steal at least some souls from that ugly monster of hell, through prayers and actions.

I was informed of the death of the superior who was at Quarachi, Sister G. Burchi, foundress of some sisters. 164 I saw her after the Communion and also in my room but I did not know her while she was alive. Many times she || desired to be visited. She came twice, but only today from the description that my secretary gave me was I able to identify her. In this way it escaped from my mouth and the secretary who understood came many times insisting to hear about her but I always changed the conversation. They told me that she suffered much and that she had a long sickness. Now I see another one with the miter; who could he be? Not to be able to distinguish is a pain for me.

How that monster tried to frighten me today! 165 It was something big. || As if I had a hand that tightened my mind so that I could listen only to foolish thoughts of no value but sufficiently pushing such that I forced myself to pray. I struggled much and I overcame. My Love, with your help everything is won.

The work done under the guidance of such a master becomes pleasant

7 May 1890. Last night that monster disturbed me! It had certain eyes, a frightening mouth that was horrible to see; with ruffled and straight hair it was coming close and the face was so big, without exaggeration, it could have been forty centimeters in width. || 166 I would say that I never saw a similar monster in the painting; after this others and then a dark face. This as usual came to visit me; certainly one of those who will die. Some time passed and then I slept.

When I woke up, I started meditating as usual and I was very united with my God. In this way after the meditation I felt strong enough to go to my Good in the chapel. 167 At the end of the prayer I went to work with my sweet master who in those days suggested clearly with words and impulses just like || a sweet father would do with a small child. How any work was easy, and why not? With such a direction, it is truly joyful; the toil becomes the sweetest pastime because something of joy, sweetness and calmness of paradise is felt. Oh, when I feel to have my Good near me, I fear nothing not having to think not even to rack my brain, because everything is ready in my mind without doubts, without thoughts that could disturb me. ||

168 Oh, my Love, do not leave me anymore! My side, what I feel! I would like to be consumed once by your love! No, to suffer and live suffering for you; not my wish but yours my God!

The Institute is being consolidated, its wings are spread

I wait for one thing. I say this because I feel a strong foreboding of… because I am not able to explain myself but it is as if I knew that a good and consoling event was at hand. 169 Oh, my Love, what will it be? I see the Holy Mother cheerful and beautiful; it will certainly be something for her Institute. ||

I cannot understand well what will happen. When I think of the tribulations that are there and to see that they afflict me little or not at all, I cannot do other than bless my God for reducing me to this. To see certain humiliations with ingratitude connected to them, with whispers on certain tiny things or rather inventions… Before I was listening to them in a singular way and I offered them to my God but interiorly they were new things. 170 Now they had changed for me in much indifference! Who worked in me like this? || My God! What an infinite mercy! As weak as I am what would happen to me?

I understand it; I could not stay, while with this indifference I feel nothing.

Yes, my Good, how can I thank you?

Every now and then he let me see how his Institute is being consolidated and how it spreads its wings and flying carries charity where it is set. How this sight comforted me! 171 I always find myself to have some small event and I cannot avoid exclaiming: my love, how much || mercy!

How he always suggests to me the smallest things, even when he desires that I go to visit more one person than the other; and if I want to go out of my will, I am not capable, there is something that stops me and there is no way of doing it. But when it is his will everything is plain and he orders me to go. Sometimes I receive his orders after the thanksgiving of the Holy Communion and immediately I reply:

  • 172 Okay, let me finish and soon I will do what you order me.

//

In fact I do not delay an instant to carry them out, if it is going as well as writing what my Good commanded me and I always find everything to be necessary: to have taken that step to recommend, now through letters I had to write to have something, now recommendations and finally a word, everything.

  • What an infinite goodness to lower himself to a filthy creature and have much charity!

Oh, how many times things have to be repeated for me because I am so ignorant || and I do not understand immediately!

173 Be patient, my Love, and think that I suffer when I hear things being repeated because I had not been prompt enough in carrying out your wishes which are like orders for me and I would like to carry them out quickly.

“Now it pleases my Good that his Work is governed more calmly”

10 May. Peace and perfect calm continued in me in everything that I must do; even in the negotiations of the houses I am so indifferent that I do not recognize myself. Within myself I go on saying:

  • 174 What a change!

In the early period, the anxiety of seeing || the Work of the Lord come up everywhere and the Daughters of St. Anne spread all over the world caused me fidgets. Why this change now? Interiorly I feel something that is indescribable. I am perfectly indifferent to everything, averse to the desire of our being called abroad. And the others, when I think that they will go, others who have been preferred to us, I feel much pleasure and I prefer to hear their good more than if we were the ones to have done it.

What a grace! A fire as I was never being satisfied in wishing to go; || now it is completely the contrary. 175 I examine myself to determine if this indifference comes from coldness or something else that came in as laziness.

But it’s not. In my examination it is something else and then I am persuaded that it is all the grace of the Lord because I delight more in the good of others more than if it were ours. This is enough to assure me that it is the Work of my Good who does not want in me anything other than true perfection. 176 Perhaps at the beginning I was very prompt || such that my Good might have wanted me to work with much promptness. Now he will be pleased that his Work might be governed more calmly.11

A certain M. came and had a conversation of interest with me asking me if we would like to make a certain purchase. In that moment I understood that he wanted to know certain interests that we have; as usual I kept quiet and I tried to terminate the conversation. When he went away I was confirmed in the idea because interiorly I understood well what this M.12 wanted.

177 In this way my Good shows me what || I should write and do for certain reports that I am required to make.

Immediately I see clearly what I must do and not what he suggested to me.

Worry for the end of a person who does not believe

I see a sorrowful end for a person who belongs to me and I would like the Blessed Virgin to give me the grace of being able to find the means to discover everything materially. 178 I cannot obtain anything and if this does not happen it is because this person does not believe; how can

I make him understand how he is? Oh, what a pain! || The thought pains me.

I see an abyss of handling, the depth of every sin; it is certainly his poor soul. A horrible sight! Only my God and the Blessed Virgin could obtain his conversion for Jesus.

My Love, where will he end? Have pity of this soul! Do not allow his damnation; because he cost you a great price!

Eternal Father, abyss of mercy, move to pity and let this soul be saved and loosened from || much sad ties.13

179 I hope for everything from the Blessed Virgin and from my dear Crucifix, because I feel that I will be granted soon.

He assured me this in the meditation of this morning not with words but with the usual signs. I had a meditation that I would rather call contemplation because I was so united to my dear Crucifix that I seemed to be embracing his most divine feet. Oh, how sensible it was, feeling, seeing and embracing them to my breast!

180 My Love, sweetness without compare I am only || in you and I feel extremely happy; I care for nothing only of your sweet love. Everything is easy for me; I find nothing difficult.

My side is united to my Good, my ribs rise and in the pain I feel sweetness of union that is indescribable. In this state everything is absorbed as if it is consumed in the sweet union. 181 I have no worry but only of this: how a dew of peace and of calm remained in me for a long time and || I am very anxious to suffer more.

Sight of people who will die.

An affair solved without an advocate

15 May 1890. Two days ago a soul came to visit me, a sister who will certainly die. She stayed motionless for a while but she was so upset in the face that I was unable to recognize her. 182 After I had news regarding the Institute: what I must do in certain things and how I must remedy what happened. I also had much union with my Good; in this way || I always see, feel and find every good in him.

My Love, what happiness, only you and nothing else! Another priest who will die and this I recognized: he was a confessor. Oh, what sweetest love, what mercy without compare, even the smallest things he suggests to me!

I had to reply to a lawyer: soon he made me interrupt everything and he showed me that he would take care of everything; he did not like that affair to be settled. 183 That was what happened, not having answered || and I was interested… it happened as Jesus my sweetest master had told me.

How easy I find the work! What an ass I am! My Master must lead me by hand, otherwise I am not even capable of moving.

My Love, how can one not be consumed for you! I am ready for everything that you, my Good, command me. It is very consoling to work under your direction, loving Saviour!

A vision accompanied by a “unitive” experience

184 But when I think of my poor spirit || which is deprived of certainty for a long time as before…

Every time I prayed there was a union in me that was enough to make me calm. Now, only sometimes – and if this were not there I would not live – how many cold days I passed and in the prayer a crowd of foolish things occupy my mind and they do not allow me to have the concentration I desire.

185 It is a continuous exercise that of driving away, though they might be just frivolous and where I am able I combat;

|| they bring me much suffering.

It is odd: I had a beautiful vision, a union with my Good and I was fully in him as I said many times; his voice gave me many instructions. Latter I passed to such a miserable state that roused pity to see that I found comfort nowhere, and abandoned in this way I would have desired to torture myself with the discipline until bleeding.

186 I had to say that I feel held back by an invisible hand and soon this || thought comes to my mind:

  • Would not this be the enemy that makes me feel this so that I do not follow the penances?

The desire of having a director is renewed. The response of a wise Cardinal

I reason within myself and I end up feeling an interior anguish that I have to force myself so that they may not realize. Only then the desire of having a director who could take care of my soul is renewed.

187 Oh, my sweet Love, have pity on this poor slave of yours who groans and suffers much to be deprived of you, || my Good. This arouses in me the fear of having disgusted you:

alas, this is the most terrible pain there could be.

Nothing could make me suffer; even the gravest thing that could be there would not be compared to the smallest portion of such terrible pain: it is an unbearable torture!

My Love, a thousand pains but do not leave me deprived of your sweetness. I am ready to renounce even this provided that you assure me || to be with me.

188 In these days my state is so painful that it is impossible to describe what I feel. Everywhere I turn I find nothing to understand myself because I am so upset by every kind of wind. It seems to me to be out, away because I do not know how to confess well and I do not know how to discern well my faults; I am full until above my hair. To have gone astray could depend on that; because with a good confession everything would cease, but what can I do?

189 I think and think again. I do not know where || to search for. It is as if I do not find I have done something wrong. And yet I feel an abyss of imperfections.

  • Where is it? – I go on saying – is this a fault? And I see that it is not. What chaos! What confusion! I realize well that it is the enemy but when it is united with fear then there is something painful. Certainly if I could have a guide I would find myself much less in such a painful state.

190 This fact is curious: I asked a wise Cardinal, one really of great spirit, || what happens when a soul walks in this manner and I made him understand that I was without a guide. This is what he answered:

  • God wants to make the soul walk on different paths, be calm.

I told him that I feared much and he assured me that this might be what pleased God. Oh, how I remained calm! Furthermore I gave him only a hint as I wrote above. If a soul could run and be sure of not making mistakes.

As I said this, he answered as I wrote above.

191 Oh, therefore, my Good, it is your || will that I stay this way; let it be!

“God has accepted my poor offering to be a victim for his Work”

18 May 1890. How much I suffered yesterday! My God, how can I describe it? Every side of my body had its pain.

I fainted all the time and the unrest was so strong in me that I was discouraged without being able to pray. I only said:

  • My God, accept this pain to amend what will happen in your Institute. 192 I understand what this suffering means and anxious I would like to know || where and how an offense against you will happen. Alas, what a cruel thought is this!

Certainly it is someone… Oh, do not allow it, my Love, no!

Today I feel better. Interiorly I feel I have made amends for this, as a voice assured me, that everything has come to an end and the Work of the Lord would not suffer. 193 This is of much comfort because it gives me peace and takes away from me that unrest from which I suffer as a person that feels the nearing || of people who want to do some evil; she fears and does not want them to come close. Meanwhile in that state in which she is it is sure those people will come, and painfully she will feel the wound; therefore she wants to find the means to drive them away. But how? Oh, what a pain! This happens to me very often because I feel everything that takes place in the Institute.

Yes, my Love, your slave must carry the burden of all the sufferings of your Work! 194 Oh, if with every kind of suffering

I could free || your Institute from any kind of tribulation and evil!

The most merciful God accepted my offering to be a victim for his Work…

I am unworthy, I see it, and I am deeply convinced.

It is your charity my God, to accept this slave so that with it she could in some way be less deformed in your presence.

Eternal Father, for the merits of the Crucifix, || I hope for everything, my sweet love!

Presage of sad events

195 22 May. Last night, towards eleven on the wall to the south, I saw much black; inside it there were certain signs which I did not understand well. Could it be an epidemic, my

God? It vanished and after ten minutes it reappeared; it was a big circle all black as a firebrand and it had a circle around a much extended width that was clearer. Could it be a very black soul? This was too big! Finally I || understood nothing. 196 It left me not very much of an impression and I did not bother to know; certainly it was something grave, but not of a soul, because the sight would be different. Rather I believe that it was something that will happen.

The state of a sister worries me much and I fear. Only my God can free her from her sickness; it is a real pain. 197 In the same way another one that I always think there is something wicked in her and who does not want to be released; || I feel pain for her!

In these days I feel much calmer and no more tormented by that thought not to be able to explain well in the confessional. Why did I go badly? Unfortunately I realized that it was diabolic action. Oh, how watchful is the enemy, tries to enter on all sides; but my Good does not allow him. How it torments all!

A sister freed from diabolic possession cause of the tumor she suffered

A poor sister, a very good one, unfortunately had to suffer much. 198 By the act of the devil she suffered much and still suffers because || her healing is uncertain.

How much I think of this! My God what a horrible monster! With certain suggestions it said that this sister was in a deplorable state and it persuaded me. How restless I was! I prayed much and it did worse in the prayers: they were things I cannot describe. Finally I entrusted myself to my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore:

  • Tell me, what does this creature have?

She replied quickly:

  • It is not what you think.

199 And with other interior words she told me that prayers were || needed, but that the big, terrible beast was in her possession. Well, what did I do? I promised to discipline myself until bleeding at the feet of my Good, though I knew

I would remain without strength and I would have suffered a lot. However, to free this creature I had to do it; in fact, I was able to drive away the dragon and she was healed. The swelling disappeared but it was obstinate! 200 Only with blood was it obtained… || Oh, how many poor creatures will be badly tortured like this! I saw what these monsters do inside the creatures. Oh, how I clearly saw! They became obstinate and they cause tumors which in these days bring many operations. My God, it is the beast of hell! In these times there is an infinite invasion! 201 The whole world is so full that there is no doubt that the sicknesses could come || from it and yet…

I saw another beast with the miter and also a lady and then a long skeleton. This certainly indicated the death of a priest. I had another vision of people but I did not recognize them. After I remained so depressed by some afflictions but I cannot understand how they could weaken.

I entrusted everything to my God and said:

  • Perhaps he might think of it. 202 That the most merciful

God || had allowed it so that by suffering I may bring benefit to what was taking place and instead that his suffering may facilitate the victory which certainly will not delay.

My sweet Love, it is sweet to suffer for your Love!

The month of Mary. “For you sweetest Mother, to live and to die fully in your heart”

26 May. The tribulations are always harbored; for God’s mercy they never cease, and they are presented so to say with new arguments, unexpected and certainly very odd in the quality of tormenting. 203 But I am || always calm and this is all work of my God who directs me in the adversities and I always see clearly his guidance.

Oh, my sweet Love, suffering is very dear to me because through it I feel I am with you.

Oh, nothing worries me; I carry everything only in him. Now, I try with all my strength, to make very beautiful this month dedicated to the Blessed Virgin.

204 The prayers of all the sisters are particularly encouraging. || Many of them are so animated that they continually seek to please Mary, the great Mother of God. How consoled I feel to see the novices who compete to reach the greatest number of spiritual communions all in honor of the Blessed Virgin. Certainly I am the lowest in everything.

Oh, how miserable I feel and capable of doing very little things pleasing you, loving Virgin! But what I feel is immense; I would destroy myself and pour my blood for you, dearest Mother. || 205 Yes, I will discipline myself for the whole of “Ave Maris Stella” and may my blood be in reparation for many offences that your divine Son receives. For you, sweetest Mother, to live and to die fully in your heart! Most sweet love, Jesus and Mary!

How to acquire the virtue of humility

206 How much I am convinced that the virtue of humility is acquired with much and continuous exercise of acts contrary to everything that could be the feeling of being and wanting to be someone; being always watchful so that the minimum desire of || gratification of what one is doing may not enter but having in front the thought of our nothingness and a low concept of ourselves. We need as well to arouse in us the repugnance that at the end and with the continuous exercise of these concepts little by little the persuasion is formed that whatever is in us and ours is nothing but filth. 207 One must take care not to be overwhelmed by humiliation || because the soul suffers in this state and there are moments in which it remains very discouraged that one cannot find peace especially if the Beloved of our soul, the sweet Jesus, is hidden. Then it is a terrible struggle. Only my Good could describe well this pain that he himself makes his bride experience. 208 He is rather pleased to purify her with this trial and after the struggle || and the pain or rather the agony, my sweet Love, your sweetness wipes away everything and gives back the strength and the vigor to run on this path. All the sweetness and beauty are in suffering in peace and resignation. I say the truth for the work that my Good did in me I am not able to understand what humiliation is and many times I say:

  • 209 My Good, if I do not feel these humiliations anymore what merit can I have? ||

An interior voice answered me:

  • This is all my doing and your soul will always have much benefit even when not feeling the pain.

Worry for the sisters in journey

28 May. This morning at half past four I saw much light;

there seemed to be two souls of our dear sisters that were going to heaven.

  • How beautiful they are – I said within myself – who could they be?

I was not able to understand; later on again but I saw only one. My God, could they be those in the sea?

I desired to know much, but nothing; this evening again

|| she came close to me, very beautiful.

  • 210 But, who are you? - I asked.

I could understand nothing, but I remained calm regarding the sisters in the sea, because they would be all, not only one. Meanwhile I am in much pain. I understand that it is certainly abroad, because if it was in Italy, it would have already been known. How painful this state is, my Love! To see and not to know anything! I must only wait for the news to come when it will be willed by God.

My Love, I would like that in this month dedicated to your Mother Blessed Mary || you may grant me 211 the grace

(…) that I desire much. I made this prayer today before the altar while I heard, if I am not mistaken, a sign of approval.

Oh, if God in his infinite mercy not considering my unworthiness would like to console me!

Meeting with Cardinal Verga:

the Foundress thinks of him as Protector

30 May. His Excellency Verga14 came and after having a long conversation about certain things regarding the Institute, I said a word for my… that needed much. 212 After he went away and I asked in my prayer to my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore if he was the one who would || take the direction and if I must say something.

  • Not at all, not at all; he wants to know but do not say anything if you are not questioned much.

  • He will do good or bad? – I asked.

  • Good, very good.

  • Will he approve the Rule?

She answered nothing.

Last night how I suffered! As soon as I lay, on the bed, loud noises were heard as if in the straw- mattress I had big beasts that moved now to the feet and then through the whole straw- mattress. What a pain! 213 Immediately it impressed me but soon I calmed down. || I started to pray peacefully such that after some time they stopped.

But what a night! After only half an hour of sleep I woke up and what did I suffer! A revolution in the whole body and I lamented without thinking that I could be heard. Oh, what I suffered!

The sister who slept a bit far heard me and came to the door to ask me what the matter was. 214 She pleaded with me to open for her, but I did not open and I asked her to go back || to bed and that I needed nothing.

This morning the meditation was a union with my Good on the wound of his side. Oh, how I stayed well! Many times I would like to write the lessons that my Good gives me but because of my little capacity, I am not able especially the times that I did not see anything in certain people who at first seemed to me good and could do good to the Institute but later on this was not true, and I was informed.

215 Some times I even fear of being || mistaken; I must touch with my hand that it was true and there was not illusion not even diabolic action. But my Good with interior voice forestalled me and in those cases I remained cold and waited for what could be explained better. 216 Soon I stopped everything, I did not compromise anymore and when I saw the fact was as the suggestion that I received, then I thanked my Master and with much fervor I put myself at work || to drive away every danger and put in to practice everything that I heard interiorly.

Slanders against the Institute kindled by the enemy of hell

4 June1890. I had a very frightening visit by a black monster as black as soot near the picture of the Holy Mother

St. Anne.

Oh, this tells me clearly that it is for your Work, my Mother!

It did not delay to be verified, The next day there was the anger of a person who loved much the Institute and was informed badly by an evil tongue. I suffered much! What a dread for what he was able to do!15 ||

217 Finally I was able to know because I am always informed by these monsters. They do not come to inform me. They even try to hide everything, but for their punishment God wants that they come for their humiliation. In this way at the beginning and when they do the evil they are obliged to come.

For some days I have been seeing a miter. Who could it be? A Bishop who always laughed at things that did not even exist; and yet he wanted them to exist. ||

218 It is very painful. I confess it and I suffer immensely. This monster always goes whispering to their ears and in this way finds a new pretext. Oh, how terrible is this devil! As soon as it finds something, a pretext of weakness or it is able to do something, it runs quickly. Oh, what pains are these, my God, to see and hear certain slanders, so horrible! My breast breaks and there is nothing except the comfort of my Crucifix || who has been much slandered for my love.

219 If it was not for the dear and sweet Jesus, certainly nothing could be done! It could only be said: To you and for you my sweet Love!

Always ahead until Golgotha!

The ugly monster soon comes to increase the tribulation occupying my mind with suggestions:

  • Do this! Take this remedy in order to end these slanders!

220 My Love, with your || strength I will overcome and this filth will retire mocked.

Oh, how much one suffers! There are moments in which everything has ended and there is no escape. Oh, only then my Love comes to my help and I have enough for every thing from the most powerful sovereign of heaven and of earth.

  • Oh, enough! – I say.

Because he is the only one who can comfort. 221 If all the creatures could be put together and all could search for words of comfort in comparison of the only || and the least comfort that is received from my Beloved…

Everything I said of the creatures all put together is really filth, nothingness, a disgusting action; there is no minimum comparison with what is received from my Love.

Precautions before increasing her penances

222 Only today I was calm because in these days I will say that there was much change, horrible because everything was united together to show me that I would not come out from that abyss || of affliction; that they could always heap and I could have suffered in such a way that the nature itself could be depressed. I was almost to get sick, but did not.

On the eve of the closure of the month of Mary I had promised to the Blessed Virgin a well done discipline until bleeding. 223 With the recitation of the “Ave maris stella” I did it with pleasure, I suffered the consequences, and this enemy of mine was defeated. ||

I said to myself:

  • Do you want to be sick for the afflictions and the slanders, the pains of all types which you suffer? Take this again and in this way you will end up suffering.

In fact morally I was healed. It was true that I reduced it to exhaustion and under my control; 224 I felt less pain. I always fear that even in this, the enemy may not put its part but my Good gave me a lesson || on this. In this way before increasing the penances I take well all the precautions and I increase them to that degree where I find this ass in strength.

I realize what the penances produce in me is strength not to give up my duties towards the Institute. In this way if they make me nimble in the activity and if my mind gets 225 more knowledge… Finally what my master taught me; the one who very carefully runs after his footprints will not be mistaken and reaches the top of the mountain without || realizing. I cannot understand how a soul who loves Jesus much can have certain ways of doing things. This is enough; I do not want to explain because I fear I might be understood.

My Master, take care to enlighten them and to make them know how they are deceived!

Presage of horrible punishment in the world

226 Seeing clearly the punishment that my Jesus was to send,

I suffered much and I felt out of myself because of the pain, as one who cries for help and does not find it. She is confused and loses hope of being granted; || she is struck dumb, turning here and there without concluding anything. My God, have pity!

The streets were a brook-let of blood, only corpses were visible and no one killed; they were falling dead without being killed. It was an invisible hand that deprived them of life. Alas, what a dread! If I think of it I feel much fear.

My Love, have pity on me! More than anyone else I merit to be wounded and punished but because of your mercy forgive me and ward me off such a terrible || scourge!

227 Your Work, your Daughters of St. Anne, save all, my Love!

I had another affliction in these days: I saw a Daughter of St. Anne who died in America; her soul was very big and beautiful! Oh, how many merits must this poor soul have! Before she died, a very big star with a kind of a ray around it came; then it came again before entering paradise: it moved around me as if it wanted to || speak.

228 It said nothing, but made a feast. Many times it came back and always shining with an extraordinary beauty. My God who could it be? Certainly a Daughter of St. Anne who loved me much, from her manner and from the signs she gave she expressed what she wanted to say. 229 One time as if she thanked me, another time as if she comforted me with joy that she would have prayed for me where she was and that I should || care for her. As if she said:

  • I am away physically but I will think of you through prayers; then that I should send someone to replace her. What a pain! I wait for letters anxiously and at the same time I fear as someone who wants to know but feels pain to hear painful news. Who knows who could it be?

The next journey to Naples. “If one does not want to suffer, it is a sign that she/he does not love”

6 June. 230 Last night, how many beasts! But all without legs and black as soot, only the body was visible and they were made as tortoises. || But as soon as they appeared they disappeared; it was worthless. I think they were chased from a good person; they would like to put evil but they are unable and then they crouch and they go away.

I prepared myself to leave for Naples; that was what my Good wants and I feel ready. 231 This is his will because I feel it and more so he shows me practically the necessity that I go there. This is his will and yet my || nature feels much repugnance because I am depressed and I feel very sick. But my Good will give me strength. I go and he will take care of what I will be in need of. 232 Furthermore I offered to him this hard sacrifice begging him to give me in exchange much providence so that I can pay every debt that is in the house, I mean in the two houses; that one of Piacenza is truly in debts since it has much! ||

Well, if I am not deluded, my sacrifice pleases my Good very much and interiorly I feel the certainty that he will give me everything.

Oh, my Love, for so little! A rotten body wounded, filthy to see! My sweet Love, when I say this I feel an interior voice:

  • Your wounds are dear to me and the pain they give you pleases me. 233 If one does not want to suffer, it is a sign that she/he does not love || and knows not what it means to love because all the delights are found only in suffering.

My Love, it is sweet to suffer for you if for so little you give me so much; if I could have a thousand lives to sacrifice them all for you. The repugnance I feel in traveling is much;

I do not find words to express it and yet this is what you chose for me, my Love.

Three mysterious incenses, sign of pleasure of the Blessed Trinity

17 June. I came back from my brief but tiresome journey.

I received much from my Good especially || the strength. 234 I always went looking at how something was happening in me and something I did not experience for a long time. In fact I supported very well the toil and without headache. As I said, I had much strength. From the time I was in Naples on the third day in the morning I was meditating as usual while lying down. It might have been five o’clock when I felt incense. Oh, how sweet that scent of incense was! 235 I did not give it much importance thinking it came from somewhere. ||

It got finished and after some minutes, it was there again less strong and delicate. Then within myself I said:

  • Perhaps they might be the sisters? No, they are not yet in the chapel, where did it come from?

I continued my meditation and it was there again and this time three incenses as little smokes.

  • My Love, what does it mean?

Nothing; but within me I felt much consolation, a union with my God and then another one… But this stayed throughout || the day and the next day, but I did not know anything. 236 After four days I had the explanation; now I do not know how to say the exact words but the meaning of those incenses was that God was pleased with one and all the actions I did. He showed me his pleasure three times with all the three divine persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. Oh, how this explanation consoled me! He suggested to me much of what I must do to turn away from sin many creatures. 237 It was || a true consolation to know that I took them miraculously out of the clutches of the devil.

Oh, my Love, I am exceedingly happy to see you satisfied with my effort to save souls seen by you only and not by human beings.

Oh, how in this I find all my pasture! 238 I would like that not even the air sees what my Good does in me and makes me work for him. I wish that he may give me the grace || to find the means to convert the whole world.

“The money was increasing in my hands”

Today while I settled the bills, and they were many, I felt moved because the money was increasing in my hands; I always gave and this multiplied.

My Love, I can say with much sincerity that I am your slave who knows nothing, and has never done anything. It is only your small ass who goes where her master sends her.

239 But out of ignorance many times I have not been able to do well until the end what my || Good ordered me to do.

Oh, my love, my ignorance and incapacity are without limit but much more and surpassing everything is the love that I have for you! Every breath of mine is only for you, my God!

I am always alone, with my Good, in peace and in the silence of my work. In you I feel nothing else except to do and to stay at the orders of my God. I am happy when I can hear a word of his which tells me that he is happy. 240 In the same way when through certain signs I understand || what I should do and if it is pleasing to him, an impulse to carry on that work. If not, I feel much resistance and I clearly understand that word, that action was not pleasing to him.

Then soon I stop and I do not carry it on. I feel I have a habit to this and I am very sure of not being mistaken because what I feel is very clear.

241 Oh, when I think of having been so infamous and still posses much mercy given to me || by my Good, I feel lively gratitude and there are moments in which I would destroy myself for my Love.

Noises in the room. Apparitions

20 June. The day before yesterday night how much I suffered! 242 Only God could say it because from eleven until morning the monster devil tormented me in a fearful manner with pistol-shots in the room. They left me so upset that I was unable to lie down but after the gun-shots it came with general epidemic signs so || frightening that the restlessness was growing in me. My prayers and meditation were done with fear. In the evening I was still upset, and not able to find peace anywhere. At a minimum I jumped; after this I did not sleep at all!

A shaking and soon I looked towards the sunset and I laughed. There was a priest, a person of some dignity and where? Inside a golden, beautiful cage. || 243 Within me I said:

  • If he were the Pope, he could have been dressed in white. But it was not possible for me to see his face. They carried him away as if he were on a sedan-chair. He walked for a meter and then he vanished. What could this be? I heard nothing. I must say that I had the news of the Bishop who sometime ago came to show himself and that he would die. He was the Bishop of La Paz, M.J. Bosche. How close he came to me! 244 May God in his infinite mercy call him || quickly to the heavenly city of paradise. Another sister came to visit me announcing to me that she was going to heaven.

That beautiful soul of a Daughter of St. Anne stayed always before me. Oh, how beautiful she was! What mirth she made around as if she wanted to say:

  • I am able to see my good, I possess him.

She came now in the chapel and then in the study room. Oh, I await letters from America; it is certain that she died there. 245 What emptiness she might have left soul dear to God! ||

Three days of complete retreat. First day:

“I think of the souls who live in the cloister”

Today 28 June 1890. It is the first day of my retreat. I asked to have three days of severity and much austerity. First: to deprive myself of everything, even saying a word, strict silence in the room and in the chapel. After the holy Mass and Communion a long thanksgiving with prayers for many people entrusted to me; then in the room until half past nine.

Today I meditated and I did a bit of reading, then more prayer in the chapel and I remained until quarter past eleven. 246 What pains! I felt faint and I had || a strong headache! At noon they brought something for me and as I finished lunch, I put a bit of order in the room, the things which are necessary and then in my mind I went to the desert. I meditated with my Good and I remained until two o’clock deprived of drinking; this was for the souls in purgatory. The heat that I suffered in this room is for the sinners so that they may be converted. 247 The pains which I humbly bear, so that the Lord may deign || to give perseverance to the Daughters of St. Anne and no one may fail in her vocation. The meditation from four to five was so that he may grant to the Institute of the Daughters of St.

Anne the true spirit of humility and may never allow that the seed of hell, pride, come to their home; 248 that all of them may be so humble that through this virtue they may edify many. ||

From five until seven o’clock I prayed for people to whom

I am indebted; from eight to nine o’clock for the benefactors, the penances Cat. Dead, Co. M.; and the last day discipline until bleeding.

This morning after an hour of meditation and having recited some short prayers, I prayed for a Daughter of St.

Anne whom good souls say is in purgatory. It seemed to me she was in a corner of the church and I asked her if she suffered. No, she was cheerful. I offered for her my strict silence and I asked:

  • Do you need anything more?

She answered no, and she thanked me. || 249 She told me that I relieved her much, but she needed a bit more. Oh, poor creature! Everything was a lack of observance of poverty. My

God, how they frighten me!

While I meditated there was another head with a miter, and this was fully embroidered with roses. The person who carried it was white and very old; it was a bit tighter than the others and with a big opening. It seemed different from the others and those rose… Who could it be? 250 I must say that the miter was like the one of the Armenian bishops, but in truth

I have never || seen one like that. It passed in my mind that it should be like that.

How well one stays in solitude! This first day passed like a flight that seemed to me I dreamt from the morning until now that the day is concluded. In everything, and in all one searches for God and remains in God. Oh, my Love, how sweet! I think of those souls who live in the cloister and are away from the turmoil of the || world.

251 Oh, no my Good, you wanted me here on the cross and I embrace it and in these days of solitude I will weep for my sins. With these I offended you many times, my Love, and the cross that I carry on the breast might have been badly carried, adored and honored. I will make a firm and refined examination: 252 I will try to carry it with love and in the middle of the work I will try to || maintain solitude within this heart of yours, my Love.

The remembrance of her very sick son Alessandro

How my Love showed me clearly the work he does in my soul. Oh, how much it cost him and how and with what charity he works in my bad character and he stops in me the smallest things as if I were unable to say neither to do nor to think; when I want to say something I am stopped. I would do something in which there would not be perfection. Stop! 253 Feeling caught like this I go back. I think and I see || that it had some small imperfection in it. In this way in a word I can say everything. What mercy!

Unfortunately who knows how many times, my Love, I have resisted your action and have thrown on one side your immense mercy!

Oh, if I could describe what my Good always does and has done in me! 254 But I am so ignorant, that if I had not the thought that what I write might make them laugh || they would see more of what I always say is true: that is, I have never been good in doing anything and I never did anything, I am incapable of everything, ignorant and true ass.

I see that the things move and are done but who does them? My Good. Oh, only his infinite mercy will be able to cover my meanness. How I would like to make amends for the damage I caused to his Work.

255 My Love, have mercy on me! ||

How much I suffered today! While I was alone, I fainted and seemed to be dying. What did I promise to do for my Good in these three days I am only in him? Oh, how much suffering! How the devil, who worked much, tormented me! In this day, now you will die… In addition

I made the sacrifice of not hearing news not even of

Alessandro and of the other family; 256 nothing. Alessandro is very sick, but my sacrifice is complete. ||

A voice in chapel – it was an interior – made me hear that this was the sacrifice, the most painful because very sensible.

Mary, Virgin most holy, my Mother, only you can tell of what kind is this pain for my children; there is no sorrow that could be compared to it. I, poor and miserable, experienced them all, but one that is equal to this I had not found. There are moments in which I say:

  • What might have happened? He might have worsened?

And the other family?

My Love, this deprivation is strong; you are the only one who is capable to make me bear such || a cruel sacrifice!

257 Patience! My Love, I will do everything for you!

Last night the second of my retreat, I felt I could not resist anymore the pain I suffered on my head, in the bones and in my whole body. I thought I would faint. How much the ugly enemy studies and does to me! It would need much to describe them!

It said that this retreat has no value since my silence was not out of love for the creatures but that I did not speak to them out of grudge. 258 Oh, on this || I answered:

  • You are foolish and a laughing stock, go away! Even now, ugly snout, you would want to say and teach me something and how it must be done!

Oh, that silence cost me much. It was the most painful because I was not able to know anything about whom I desired to have news and it was of much sorrow for me. But for my Love everything is little, for him every deprivation becomes sweet because I feel him fully in me. 259 In this way the enemy tried to disturb me in everything and with very subtle astuteness tormented me; || troubles will come these days with my retreat and the Work of the Lord would suffer. How many things it put together!

“Speeches that the intellect formulates and it seems that they are others who make them”

I went to the feet of my dear Crucifix and I made an hour of meditation. I was absorbed and I saw my Good, the Saviour. Then another personage who with a loud voice said:

  • I am destined to destroy the world:

260 First it was very sick with something badly placed on the head. Then it was transfigured and was left as dead || falling into pieces, while it said that it was to destroy the world. That was how all the changes were taking place; what could it be? A certain odd discussion came to my mind as if there was someone in me who spoke and reasoned answering to himself. It was very nice and I liked the story of a Cardinal really a prince of the Church, a man of exemplary virtue who also used to do certain penances. 261 He said that he would like to know something about me but then he answered || that he would like to know of one or more penances I did. He continued so much that I said:

  • I will send them to you.

How can I? But this voice stayed much in this way; I say much to mean a quarter of an hour and it made me laugh much. Oh, how! And then it contrasted me as if I did not want to say at all how it could happen, whom and how such comes. 262 My Love, Jesus! They are discussions that the intellect formulates and it seems that others form them while it is the intellect that reasons. || When they are things of the spirit most of the times it is me who thinks them and then that thinking becomes true. What I thought about happens.

It is true, my Love: how many times it happened fully or partially. 263 But this morning it was very odd for many nice small things all in you my God, and I felt some consolation in hearing them because even your Institute was included. || If what I heard will take place, I would truly be happy.

I went down to the chapel and I had a long conversation with my daughter sister Anne del Salvatore; she calmed me regarding the health of the one who was very much in my mind and in the same way I desired to know if my Good would give me a grace that I sought much. She told me that he would give me everything when I expected them the least.

Second day of retreat: “A sweet school for me”

Today I had many deprivations in food as well as in other things. I have no relief at all. 264 Always with my || God with prayers and spiritual communions. Oh it is very sweet to stay with you, my Love!

Today, second day, I meditated, I made very few vocal prayers and I said them with difficulty. I stayed very well with my Good, now at his side where I stayed well, how I do not know…

Oh, my Love, why should I still… No, I will never say.

I want to stay here as long as you want me, even if it is an eternity of sufferings, Eternal Father!

Oh, sweet reasoning, how I am still behind in heavenly knowledge!

265 In these days || I truly have had a sweet school. Making a timetable is for me something of a laughing stock because now is late evening of the second day and something equal to the first day I realize I never did.

And why? I was supposed to do vocal prayers but I was lost in meditation. My Good gave me the opportunity of contemplating and when I find myself like this I get lost and the time passes without my realizing it. Before I lay down, again a bit of meditation; I stayed embracing my dear

Crucifix. || 266 In him I have many things to be negotiated; it seems something incredible that for the mercy of my God in this solitude and always thinking of myself and my God nothing that could disturb me came to my mind of having done this past time. Oh, my Love I am alone and always in the midst of many affairs! The same is for the things of my soul and until now I have no thought that became an obstacle.

I see it is all your work, my Love! || 267 Nothing disturbs me of the many affairs: it seems that between me and the busyness of the world a wall has stood which divides me perfectly.

Third day: “In the desert with my Good”

Third day: before I placed myself before my dear Crucifix, returning to the church I tried to see if the pain I felt in the stomach would calm a bit. Oh, what a night, I thought I was dying!

268 My Good, you gave me everything that could be suffered; thank you, my Love, for you gave me much strength to resist || without calling anybody and taking nothing for relief, nothing.

I thought of my Good and with him I climbed the very harsh desert. Even himself as God and man how much he might have suffered! He had nothing to restore him; the same is for me.

My sweet Love, I have nothing that can relieve me. 269 I suffer, at least if my suffering could be of use to relieve you while the sins of mankind and most of all mine reduced you to this: Oh, how I suffer my Love, even || now!

I leave because I feel faint.

As I finished the meditation of one hour and a quarter I felt a bit better. I still suffer but I do not faint.

I stayed in the desert with my Good. I begged him to lean on in his heart since the one I have is not mine. I would have watched so that no animal could hurt him and torment him as he rested. 270 As I said this I saw clearly that we must continually be watching ourselves because certain small animals enter || and they hurt much the divine Heart of Jesus. After I was lost with my Good and I came back to myself when a few minutes remained to the hour.

I concluded with loving affection and thanksgiving turning to the Eternal Father. As I raised my eyes he was up there.

Oh, my sweet Love! God of mercies, have mercy on me, consume me with your most divine love!

271 I felt I must return to meditate. Prostrate on the ground I will embrace my || dear Crucifix. I will not go to the church because I feel I would faint.

My Love, consume me, infinite sweetness! It is three o’clock. I have finished the discipline until bleeding and I feel exhausted. I stop for a while in order to regain the strength and to go to the chapel. My Love, few hours more and then I will return to work.

The secret of what is in her heart

What should I say of my side? What is there in this heart of yours, my Love? If I had to believe certain good souls…

272 Without having ever said what I have || one seeing me – and this was a friar – he knelt down and said:

Leave me that I may adore what is in your heart.

It could be better thought rather than described what I said and did. Even another religious of holy life, P.Do. to, wrote to me in details what I kept inside.

273 There was no need of any other answer that he might be mistaken with a good soul who would be happy to possess a similar treasure, for this poor unfortunate was very far that other than sin does not nourish and || a thousand other expressions to convince him.

Certainly when the heart is united with my God, or rather to its God, what happens? What do I feel my Love?

The swelling is increased much and everything that tightens me to the least gives me a spasm. There is no way of standing. 274 Immediately I am forced to remove everything that causes me pain. I understand that the secretaries see certain clothes that I repair badly and I hope that they || believe I have some kind of sickness. This is how I want to persuade myself. They are very kind and aware that I could suffer much; they never make the least comment. All your work, my God!16

The help of Sister Anne del Salvatore

I will say a word about my dear daughter who last night has been my help and my relief. She calmed me in the unrest caused by fear of having something which I could not resist; in this way I could not continue my retreat. My angel, what a comfort!

275 She was always ready to answer me. ||

  • My Salvatore, will it be this or another one?

  • Not at all – she answered.

  • Poor me, I feel so sick!

And she said to be calm, that it would pass. Oh, how she comforted me.

Conclusion of the retreat: the offering

It was nine o’clock and I have finished my retreat.

Yes, my Good, I suffered much, I had fulfilled my promise of not searching for any comfort and not to speak: strict silence.

276 After lunch I made my offer and before this in the prayer that I made || not in the meditation I made spiritual communions. I was lost and as I recovered I saw my dear daughter Sister Anne Francesca, not my niece, the first, that one who offered herself for me to the Lord, she was happy. It seemed to me that she assured me she would have prayed. In fact the Communion that I had to receive was for her.

I said the Confiteor with crossed arms for the last examination and it was long. Then the other one of love and the De profundis for the souls. I had already said with crossed arms twice the litanies of the Blessed Virgin. 277 Oh, how my shoulders pained! I asked || the Sacred Heart for light on one person regarding the … But I did not get what I asked for, a sign that it should not be because he always gives me proof of what I ask him and many times I see he never wants to assure me.

278 I hope to have gained much for my soul. If in some parts of my writing I spoke of “new direction” it does not mean direction of a spiritual director, but rather certain jokes that Jesus does as that one of asking something to a saintly person in abstract, in order to have the pleasure of listening and seeing if he guesses in || one word. But clearly I wrote only to C.V. to have his advice and I was satisfied.

Oh, if God could grant me this great grace that he would always be the director and advise me. It seems to me that I would come out from the sufferings which do not…

Light on the interior situation of two sisters

16 July. Two days ago I was very thoughtful about what I should do to defend the Institute from someone and it seemed to me that if I could make a certain story they would enable them to realize who the person is. In this way what he said would have no effect.

279 While I thought on this || a loud voice said to me:

  • I will take care of this.

  • It is enough, my Love; I will not speak anymore.

In fact I did not speak anymore but it was so consoling that the whole day I felt out of myself.

Oh, my Love, how you take care of everything! In the same way I saw a demon attached to the dress of a sister; I was upset:

  • What could it be?

Furthermore she was a sister who lived with me! I prayed much and thought what it could be.

Did this sister do badly? ||

  • 280 No – I heard – she is very disturbed in the spirit; she has many things which upset her and everything derives from what seeks to upset her anger, to make her lose her vocation.

I asked her:

  • What is the matter? What upsets you and why do you not drive away with strength the temptations? Woe betide you if you indulge in them! No, they are all diabolic suggestions to disturb you!

She assured me that they were already leaving her because she was feeling less anxious and she asked me how I knew || that.

281 Listen – she said – you could not know it except by inspiration!

I moved away and exhorted her not to give heed to the temptation.

The same was with another sister. Unfortunately what I felt for her was true, but by now it was very easy to understand because the signs were always the same. The same things are presented to me and I cannot fear making mistakes.

Strong desire of being removed from the office

282 I will say nothing of my journey from Rome to Pisa, Pistoia and Piacenza, because I do not know what to say; only that || I suffered much. I would like to be able to describe the impression that I felt in coming to this house of… Soon a melancholy took me and such a deep pain that I had difficulty holding my tears back. And it always continued… My God, what a pain! To see also the Holy Mother St. Anne corpse-like gave me an impression that is unbelievable. Therefore, who will die? 283 Even today I had always before me a skull of a dead person; I think of it but then || it might not be any one of those of whom I think. Oh, what a pain!

I do not understand why I have a strong desire of being removed from this office; I do not know what I would do to be removed. Everything is presented to me as insurmountable. I find myself always more unable of going ahead fearful in deciding.

I feel I am the cause of all the evil that takes place. 284 At last it might be that my Love makes me desire this because he will think of removing me from this office and put me || to serve him in places more…

Oh, my Love, this thought encourages me to hope to obtain what I desire! Certainly everything is your work because everything good that takes place in me is only your work. You are the one who with much mercy work in my garden which is very stony.

I would like to make it fertile, where no weed could grow, but only beautiful plants that produce tasteful fruits.

285 Oh, how I would be happy living in the midst of the terrible torments which || would become sweet for me.

Pains caused by the chain, that she never removed for eighteen years

Oh, my Love, yes, how I suffer in these days! The swelling takes away my breath and the chain I have enters into the flesh and causes me spasmodic pains. I do not know what to do to lose it. I fear hurting. For eighteen years I have not removed it; but only for a few minutes to put it right when only one of the rings was spoiled: something difficult because it is very strong. 286 Years could pass || in which it does not need any mending.

When I feel a strong pain then I desire to remove it but when I start doing it I fear so strongly that I stop; I am afraid of doing something bad and that it would not be the will of God.

In this, yes, it would be of great relief to have a guide who could certainly give me certainty whether or not to remove it. It is hard for me to live in this situation! My dear

Crucifix tells me nothing: || I suffer much.

287 I cannot describe the impression I received from the sight of a skull; in the same way the news of a priest who died and of whom some months earlier I had the notice.

Oh, how sure it is!

Now a miter and I see it very high; much tighter than the usual; certainly soon I will understand to whom it belonged but not now, no. But when I receive the news, I never put it into writing because I forget. The same is for certain habitual things, || I do not bother.

Assisted by God in the instructions to the novices

288 20 July. Yesterday was for me a terrible day in which I suffered much and not only physically. I carried the headache beyond the usual. In the morning a bit after my thanksgiving when I was still with my Good and I entrusted to him many things, I saw before me a picture where there were many girls.

289 One of these, very beautiful, prayed to God with clasped hands and || there was a priest whom I did not distinguish well. He was dressed in black and for this reason I say that he was a priest; he could also have been a friar but I did not pause to look at him. How much that young girl who prayed impressed me!

290 I could understand nothing of the others || whose faces were turned upside down; a deep pain remained in me. Who could they be? But I had nothing. I suffered so much that the work I was doing seemed so heavy that it could not be finished.

Oh, how my Good does everything in an excellent way! Today because he wanted to use this slave of his to instruct the novices, he gave me strength and through me he spoke what he wanted for the good of these dear creatures. 291 It is something great || only thinking of it. That an infinitely powerful God lowered himself with his infinite mercy for the good of his brides and is pleased to speak through this slave of his, the ass of Balaam. Oh, incomprehensible is his action in every movement towards the creatures. 292 Everything is great and the miserable creature is upset because she does not understand such sweetness || of action in the love God carries for his creatures; because only in him, in his infinite majesty and power such image of mercy and charity could be found. 293 I am so conscious that as I came out from the speech I did not find any other relief except the church or the room, in solitude to calm myself and say: here is your slave, who asks you for forgiveness if she has not been watchful enough for your inspirations, in || repeating them as you my Good desired and in the manner in which you desired of your creatures; that I may see them all saints.

Serenity in the face of the concept others may have about the Daughters of St. Anne

This evening I feel sorrow for the continued thought of a good friar who was the General: 294 F.B. He seems worried about our Institute and he had shades; that in all the houses of the Institute there is no equal observance because not all

|| the superiors are good or really holy souls. But one must think that someone could be less virtuous and it was based on this thought that worried him. Now it seems the thought has disappeared and he thinks of coming back.

How odd is the description of what passes in my mind while I think of what the creature is, how it lives, what it receives and good or bad impressions. || 295 I always thought of this and many years ago I was vexed and I always feared that the people who loved the Institute could become cold with the impressions that they received from someone;

these out of zeal, wanting to do good, hoping that those people could put their share of work to set in order again what they rightly saw to be ill-done.

296 I felt sad, but now || my indifference to everything is such that it can’t be understood because who feel it cannot describe it. Everything is lost in the sight of my God; he made it, the Work is his.

These are all jokes to purify the land of this field so that one day he may make it fruitful and obtain good fruits, and vines which will give wine that will be used until the end of time. The foundations signed and beaten by the holy, beautiful and delightful cross cannot be moved, || they are indestructible. 297 This evening I write but I do not know what I write; I see that my Good makes me write, and I move my hand.

I also feel that new affliction will come but I am ready my Love; you are the master and I your slave who has no other desire but doing your most holy will. Virgin most holy, Mother of my God, pray for me so that I may completely be consumed in your divine love. ||

A healing of a sister obtained by Sister Anne del Salvatore

298 22 July. Last night was terrible; tired I hoped to rest, not at all! A pain and fidgets upset me. Finally at half past eleven I slept. I was awakened by a strong pinch on one arm. Near the hand I saw a big black beast as soot. What a fright! It was shaped in a way that I do not know to what I can compare it. It had a long and big mouth; it had almost no legs. I jumped from the bed and all frightened I started looking at my arm to see if I had any sign; 299 but nothing. I searched on all sides and I said:

  • How a stupid, || that monster, to frighten me it came on my arms. Oh, what a night! I was not able to close an eye; tired I felt faint and I prayed for a grace that was very much on my mind, a poor Daughter of St. Anne who suffered much. I begged my Sister Anne del Salvatore and she answered:

  • Everything is finished, she has nothing.

  • How come? The doctors say that she needs much to be healed!

  • Everything is completely ended.

300 Today || she wrote to me that everything was ended and that she was healed. Oh, for me it was a real miracle, a very great grace that the dear Sister Ann del Salvatore obtained from God! She is for me a comfort in the midst of many pains; she always says a word of peace; she gives suggestions. Finally when I ask she answers if I must do it yes, or no as usual. She loves the Institute and all her prayers are for it. 301 Oh, I really have come to know her beautiful soul better and what she wants to obtain from Jesus. He refuses || her nothing for her Institute; it is well seen.

Another grace that the Eternal Father continually grants to his poor Institute is always to pause and give notice on time if there is something wrong somewhere.

“I would like to live one hundred years just to suffer”

302 23 July. Last night I had again the same fear of the previous night: the beast that ran over my arm and inside the arm was smaller than the other; I recognized it quickly because it was of the same shape and color. This gave me no less || impression and for the whole night I was so upset that I had to use holy water and I learned that it will never come back.

I bathed the arm and the hand; what a pain! From one moment to the next I expected a big tribulation. In fact it came: I had one after lunch, so terrible that it could never be imagined.

In a letter, a certain person said certain horrible things but I remained very calm and with || an interior cheerfulness that could not be explained. 303 Oh, how sweet is suffering! I would like to live a hundred years just to suffer.

What have you put in this suffering? What delights have you concealed in it, my Love?

In twenty-four years of vocation I can say that through

God’s mercy I never had an hour’s respite from my sufferings. And they were always new, never the same but always different.

304 They are certainly of much consolation for me and they are of || a new kind. If I could have similarities I would be very happy because I would not do other than laugh and I would not have difficulty to keep at its duty this ass that twists at the sight of suffering; it would not like to have and it moans continually in the silence of its grumbling and moaning because it wants to twist. But not, it must stay at its place.

305 Ugly beast of body, I am your mistress; || therefore, you must obey and be submitted to my will which is that of my God, the being of my life.

How much the ugly monster says and it is certain to show me that if I leave and abandon everything I will be happy and I will have many graces; at least I will live fully in the Lord. I will not hear anymore complaints, everything will be calm and I will live in peace. Oh, if I could describe how much this monster says, || it would need much time. 306 I will only say that it invents some new types and it always whispers. My Love, how terrible it is! I feel much compassion for the poor creatures who are tempted in this type of suggestion because it is so terrible that only God’s grace can save us from falling. 307 Especially when they come from people to whom we did much good, that the Institute has benefited much; || the pain certainly becomes greater; it is really sensible and torturing.

My Love, support me and with your strength I will know everything and I will have the strength to bear.

She does not accept the advice of the sacrifice not to see her children anymore
