While a certain person asked me many questions telling me everything that was said, a cloud of smoke as a thick fog covered him and all the space that was at our feet was covered.

308 My Love, this is smoke; therefore what he says is smoke || and it means that at the appearance of the sun it will be dispelled certainly. Then we hope to see clearly.

In this way from when I removed the wallet I felt very happy; it seems to have removed an enormous burden and the worry not to be able to face all the undertakings. Oh, how painful it is!

309 Another time, the same person came: first he said many things, real exaggerations and nothing else and slanders without end. They arrived to say that it would be good that I sacrificed myself || not to see my children anymore. My God! And yet this person who is a priest said:

  • You did many sacrifices, do that of your blood!

Oh, to this so persistent advice I felt faint.

  • But no – I answered – I will do what my guide will order me but I do not think that I need to go against the law of nature!

I have only one son, always sick; they assist all the sick, why not this one? And not even me? 310 Oh, this seems against

|| nature while they are very attached to their nephews, sisters and brothers! The same is right, how this affection is maintained and yet without understanding what the meaning of “son” is and the difference from nephews and sisters. I am not interested in these and I do not want to see them. But I do want to see those of the poor, deaf daughter, her children, for these if I can certainly have a good word and for her a suggestion. 311 Poor, if she could know this… Oh, her head! Certainly || I do not speak of having an extraordinary affection but a sense of duty and compassion.

And then to say that…

Oh, my Love, how these days are torturing in the midst of many accusations! 312 There are moments in which I must say I feel happy in the midst of much suffering and slanders of every kind; I feel something deep in my soul that comforts me and it is very sweet, and therefore I feel pain when I see they want to defend me and || they want to take them away. No, I regret, I pray much for these people and I feel affection for them.

The three ways of carrying the cross:

theme of instruction for the sisters

26 July. Day of the Holy Mother; how the slanders were terrible for me and the continuous sayings so much sensible.

They are truly cruel because they are very torturing in the fear that there may always be a failure, even small certainly even

Jesus is offended, therefore I am very careful. 313 I would || like to die a thousand times rather than committing even unwillingly things that torture for fear that there might be even the least offence to my sweet Love.

27 July. I felt in me a strong reproach because the day before I showed the desire that while the preacher blessed many other people, included the Institute, he may also bless me. 314 My God how much I suffered for || this desire that I revealed without thinking. What a pain! I had to ask for pardon to the secretaries because it was to them that I revealed this desire; furthermore I had repeated an accusation that was done to me and even for this I suffered much.

Weeping I said to my God that with his help I will never do it and that I would have swallowed everything without saying anything and I would have sucked the worm wood of fate always with joy.

Nobody will know my pains, only at your feet my Good I will give vent to my suffering.

315 Truly in these days it is very fierce || and I could say that the tribulations fling as fierce dogs and with such a strong and cruel diligence certain accusations are made to me without a concrete backing.

How painful it is! Within me I feel much deep pain that reaches to the marrow of my bones. Mean while an interior voice said to me:

  • There are three levels of cross.

316 Immediately I started to write everything that I felt interiorly and when I finished I was really || surprised at the thought that the one which the Lord wants from me is the third level and I will willingly embrace the cross to my breast to suck from it the essence of suffering.

I feel so deep melancholy that I would do nothing except weeping. Who knows what will happen to me because the melancholy is too much; everything that I do, I do it with difficulty and coldly which is unbelievable. I never fail in my duty.

I wait for bad news because that is what I feel; 317 my God || how much I suffer! The swelling does not allow me to breathe and the chain enters into my flesh; how much spasm it gives me!

How many black shadows move around! My God, this continues! I promised I will swallow without ever saying anything: the slanders, the anxieties, the pains; everything in silence.

318 I would have held my cross in the heart of my sweet Jesus; I will embrace it in him and often between me and my Good I will release my pain without any comfort I will suck all its || essence.

How beautiful was the description of the three levels of cross of my Good! I delighted immensely. Immediately I tried to write and to repeat them in a conference as instructions because that is what my Good desired.

I feel that I will have another instruction but it is not yet clear; it is confused. Many times it happens like this: at the beginning I feel something. 319 Oh, how odd it is that some times he stops me in the middle of a sentence and gives me no more material || to continue because everything is his; I have nothing that is mine since I am very ignorant. If he leaves me only for an instant I am unable to say anything as he does not give me the strength to assimilate what afflicts me while I say certain things only he knows.

And yet he gives me the strength to swallow and to be silent. In this way the pain that I carried on one side was so much that while I was in the dining room I thought || I was fainting. 320 To the one who was close to me and asked me if I suffered I answered nothing.

  • Your face says that you suffer – she continued.

It was true; but I said nothing in order not to lie. Saying nothing while I suffered was nothing, because it was sweet to suffer; little by little it stopped and I was able to eat without being understood. 321 Certainly, it is of much comfort to reveal one’s suffering and to have a relief but it is of greater merit to suffer without comfort || in the likeness of the Saviour.

I write out on this exercise book the three crosses; three are the ways of carrying them.

1st cross: this is the one which is carried on the shoulders for the love of God. Though they feel a heavy burden they never put it down; they only complain and talk with the superior or with the confessor to find comfort and to be encouraged, fortified and to find strength to continue their journey never putting the cross down. These are those souls who have paradise for sure. ||

322 2nd cross and the way of carrying it: those souls who desire perfection and love the Lord very much, carry it tightly on their breast and never remove it.

In suffering the burden of the same cross sometimes crushes their bones, but they find joy in it and they carry it more tightly on their breast. These are generous souls and they are favored with his strength. These reach their desired goal; they reach the desired port to possess God in the heavenly beatitude. ||

323 3rd cross and the way of carrying it: it belongs to the real lovers of the Lord who know no other comfort than in suffering. They carry it tightly in their hearts with resignation without seeking the least of comforts. Only suffering is their relief.

324 These are the souls who weep only at the feet of the Lord and in secret || pour their tears and tightly in their heart keep the holy cross, love of Seraphim and the joy of those who love. These are the holy souls.17

Oh, my Love, how much I also desire to love, to be able to learn to posses the third cross! I feel strongly the desire to start such a journey. Oh, sweet love, whoever does not love you is very unfortunate! 325 How happy I would be to let everyone know you and love you! Poor creatures! ||

Alas, how clearly I see that other tribulations will come upon me! What a pain not to know what will happen, but even from the facts that happen I fear the death of someone.

My God, could I be? As the most abject creature I do not merit to receive explanations but my sweet Good I suffer much in this state! 326 If this is what you wish let me remain even in this darkness; resigned I wait to see and to bear with resignation || what will happen to me.

Souls convinced of running well, but they are deluded

3 August 1890. The afflictions continue and in very sensible ways that I must confess they are very painful. But at the thought that everything is for my Good it becomes always sweet and with pleasure I carry this weight of suffering. In suffering I seem to be so united to my God that I leave nothing to be lost; I try to absorb everything avidly.

327 The sight of the beasts is always the same and also the other things. I suffer much and more than before regarding

|| the failures of the sisters. Before they did not afflict me much but now, how I suffer! To see a person of highranking lost in certain foolish things gives me pain. I would like to describe what I saw in him and he is more than convinced of running well but what a blunder he made!

The confessor could do everything because I thought of doing much, but it was not convenient; that is what I got. I would get nowhere because he is very convinced of running

|| well. 328 Yes, certainly even he will go to the heavenly city but this could be explained in many ways; he halts and it is not possible for him to go ahead and this is clearly seen.

Certainly these souls could progress much because with self-denial they are able to bear many things and still deny to themselves relief and comfort; everything to mortify themselves, but what is the use? || 329 At the right moment, they do not know how to put into practice, poor! In that case no one but their director, if he is very wise and ascetic and able to go deep down with these people, could certainly find the means to enlighten them.

While I was having the conference I saw a sister who seemed like a lay person; after I looked well and this from the way I saw her, she was dead.

  • 330 My Love, – I said within myself, || will this sister die soon?

The next day she started to feel sick. Oh, what an impression she left me, because in addition to seeing her dead, she was covered with certain rags which were falling here and there from the shoulders, habits which I could say the name of rags is fit. Only the impression I would have liked to be better though her face was white. 331 Certainly before she dies the Holy Mother will think to remove from her all those || rags because the depth is good; there are certain things… It is very true that it is easier to remove the big things than the smaller ones; these seem attached to the pitch. How terrible is our humanity and how we must combat if we want t o be victorious.

Apprehensions and fears. Answers of Sister Anne del Salvatore

12 August. They are various days that I always thought to write, but I had no time and my 332 poor health… At night I find it difficult to write because my poor || head is depressed from the work of the day. This evening is very late, but I feel a strong thrust to write believing this to be the will of my God. I give up resting and I put myself to work writing as well as I can what happened to me in these days.

The monster of hell tormented me and the beasts as usual; they were not very big. However I was informed of something bad and I am waiting for the news. 333 What I did not suffer to see that the monster never gives up tormenting the poor… || Later I had many instructions and communications on what I have to do in the Institute.

I still keep lively in my mind what I had after the thanksgiving yesterday; I needed to know many things. I took courage to ask to my daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore and she answered me very well.

I wanted to know if the letter I sent to a Cardinal was accepted. How she comforted me telling me that he desired it and that he would answer it! 334 After I asked her many things || she answered me very clearly. I went ahead and I asked if I will be deflated:

  • Yes – she answered – you will deflate.

For the poor Alessandro, how sad she was! She certainly shares my pain; how I feel it! It is truly strong!

Oh, my Love, my strength, come to my help! What a tribulation! Only seeing him makes me a strong wound in my breast! I try to conceal it; but how much I suffer. This violence I must make costs me dearly.

335 I always feel anxious and I fear || fainting. I do not understand yet that beautiful star that I saw sometime ago.

We will hear the news of America. Certainly when I see such beautiful stars of the Daughters of St. Anne who go to heaven, it is a true consolation for me. In the midst of much pain to see that these go to praise God and to delight in him for eternity lightens for me every pain.

336 The anguishes of these days leave me much sensitivity || that the smallest thing makes me fear much and upsets me because soon my thought is that, the way I am is infamous.

With that I always ask my God to make me expiate my sins but that the Institute may not suffer; that it may always be exempt from the least evil and everything may be done for the glory of God. My Love, have pity on me! ||

337 Only my God can bring me out from this painful state.

I hope everything from you, my sweet Love.

Presage of big tribulations.

Other answers of Sister Anne del Salvatore

13 August. What a terrible night I spent! At two after midnight I was shaken; a big black beast woke me up and ran upon me.

I jumped from the bed more frightened than ever. It left me in such a fright that I had no more courage to sleep but I went around the room for sometime.

However, the weakness overcame me and I returned to bed; but how could I sleep? || It was impossible! 338 I was always feeling upset from all sides as if the same beast still ran upon me. Oh, how bad I felt!

I signed myself and I meditated well. It was upon the wound of the right-back of my Good, that wound produced by the holy cross that so horribly stripped him of the flesh.

339 I found myself much united, but my Love I well understood || that you prepared me for other stronger and fearful tribulations. You supply me with strength in this union with you.

This was what I thought after I had finished the meditation. In fact, this morning after my thanksgiving while I prayed, I felt deep sadness accompanied by fright. But I wanted to be persuaded of this; what could have left me this way at night?

  • 340 But not! Soon I started to question || my dear daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore.

First I asked her if the Cardinal had answered my letter. In a good manner, but not like the other times she told me that he did and that I will receive it soon and that the Cardinal read it with pleasure. Then I asked the meaning of that ugly beast; 341 she answered that I was to have a bad affliction and weeping she said that this would be like a knife that would pierce me || with pain. As she wept she comforted me.

But what will it be? I asked.

She answered that she could not tell me but would pray for me, since I received the Communion for her glory and honor.

Finally, interiorly I was feeling so oppressed that it seemed my body was crushed. My God!

342 The ass pains much, I mean my bones are paining much and this went on for some days; || I felt it more than usual.

When I eat if unfortunately I swallow a bit of bread or something else not well chewed and a bit bigger than usual, how I suffer! It seems that instead of going down it comes out through the skin; this is the sensation. I feel such a torture that I do not know how to describe it. 343 The bones become more sensitive and the pain that I carry is || continually atrocious.

How much comfort is that creature Sister Anne del Salvatore! I question her in everything and she answers me so well and she never makes mistakes, not even one. From what I see, her weeping without being able to say something… What did I do? I asked her if it was something of the Institute and I saw it was a kind of big mixture of things. I hope that the Lord may give me strength because I already see that he prepares me as I said above. 344 The suffering is much, in waiting without knowing what || will happen. My Love, have pity, sweet Jesus.

The people deprived of the gift of faith deserve compassion

I do not know how such strength could be found in me to force myself so that whoever is near me would not realize my suffering. How understandable it is for those unhappy to remain very bad when they have tribulations, not knowing my Good! They really deserve much compassion because they are deprived of faith. 345 They see and hear nothing, everything is material for them and nothing more;

they live for the flesh and from it they seek || happiness which they do not find because they find themselves always more unhappy and have nothing that can satisfy them.

Completely blind they walk gropingly searching for what they cannot have and will never have if they do not enter into themselves and look at the one who can make them happy for an eternity.

How the world lives on appearances! I always hear it said that he was a person of holy life. My God, what pain I feel for I know what kind of life this unfortunate || had!

346 Well, I have decided to take counsel on what I should do, because what I feel gives me repugnance…

But the fear of failing is so great because charity seems to me stronger than saying something.

However, I never want to trust my judgment but to consult wise priests and assure myself of what I should do.

347 It is true that I have nothing to fear because I only communicate; there is no risk that there could be something || because it does not belong to us but to hear this now that…to believe has become truly difficult and one must first know the person well to be able to judge.

The machine of the body feels decadent. Indecision in acting

15 August: day of the Assumption. 348 I prayed much but I suffered much because I did not know what was taking place in the prayer: a deep sigh came out of me as if I were in a terrible pain and then a strong || union in which I felt really well; I do not know how to express it.

Always oppressed, he lets me see nothing but pains and tribulations.

My God, let it be, my Love, it is enough that your most divine will is satisfied in everything.

Always new things happen to me. I would like only one thing 349 because it seems to me that it is good to desire it that always my God be fully satisfied; I desire nothing else. ||

I feel much pain when a Daughter of St. Anne does bad things and loses not only her vocation but once she left the Institute, she falls badly. My God, I cannot express what I feel. Yesterday I asked my daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore certain things I hoped to obtain and to my understanding would comfort me because they concern the Work of God. But not; 350 she answered that whatever I did was according to God’s will but it was not yet all || that God wanted. I would have wanted her to direct me in some way or rather advised me because I must confess that I need it.

Especially when I am much oppressed I understand that this machine of my body feels decadent, I have no more the strength that I had and I easily feel oppressed.

351 The same is regarding penances: I am not able to decide alone. To diminish them I feel that my God does not want || because when I ask him he gives me no answer.

But if I start giving up I feel something that I cannot explain that is stronger than me and stops me.

This ugly humanity struggles in such a way that many times I am disturbed and for this I go on thinking if it is a diabolic act, because in this way I am worn out earlier; but then the ugly one would have won.

352 But not, I hope that my Good || may not let me be deluded by this filth and if it will see that I am at the point in which the penances would bring me a grave sickness, he will certainly not allow it. Reasoning like this I go ahead, but I cannot avoid saying that it is a strong pain.

353 I see myself deprived of human help; it is certain that if my Good would not hide – but he hides many times – I would not fear. He communicates himself in some moments

|| and then?

My Good, where are you now? How arid I am, sunk in much work! How worn out I feel!

In these days the small shadows were numerous; but they were small and I was unable to understand them. As I look at it now, I see that I had always new torments.

354 Certainly though they do not hear much, I must say that they cause evil; but thinking that I did much evil I need to expiate. I cannot avoid || exclaiming: it is all your mercy, my God; that you deign to make me expiate my sins here before appearing in your presence, because I will be less deformed.

This thought encourages me to bear everything: every slander, even the most harsh, even this I try to bear in peace with my mind fixed on what I must do to give pleasure to my God.

For him and in him I only desire to be and to be consumed for him. It is sweet to suffer for the dear and loved Jesus. ||

355 “I always fear myself more than the evil I receive”

18 August 1890. Other new sufferings came to torment me after those black shadows. This morning while I lay down and meditated they were in the room. In this way there is no danger that one could be mistaken because their notice is sure. In fact the p… came with the Canonic Co… and the first did not omit to saying certain things that were painful;

but with the help of God I was able to overcome myself and in this way to have 356 victory. || I always fear myself more than the evil I receive; this makes me suffer much and for this tribulation I lose the merit, releasing myself or taking the satisfaction of defending myself energetically and giving vent in such a way that certainly it could be an imperfection even if small and only one. 357 It is difficult to be exempt from this;

keeping quiet and waiting that this enemy of ours be calmed is good. Then reasoning peacefully || we can defend ourselves and it is certain that this defense is dictated not by passion but by duty. How good it is to keep silence in these circumstances!

Oh, my Love, if I have your help I am sure of victory at all times, even against the most adverse thing when it seems that everything is lost for me.

How do I find myself now? From yesterday and the whole of today, what darkness! 358 I understand nothing; I seem to be someone who has nothing. I feel melancholy || in everything: I do not stop to think of it because I fear that my suffering could increase, that I might not be able to bear it. Everything oppresses me. The chain that I usually carry even this tortures me so much and everything put together frightens me. I do not want to repeat what the 359 enemy suggests to me because of what I have already written about similar suggestions of the past. I will only say that it does everything that it is able to torment me. Oh, what pains! They are without relief and so sensible || that I do not know how to explain them. I suffer much but with resignation.

The example of Jesus makes us love all the gossips and the slanders

To see a person who received much benefit doing so much evil to the Work of the Lord, I feel something. Jesus has benefited you much and do you treat him in this manner?

Oh, how infinite is your mercy and clemency! How could we think of obtaining charity from mistreatment? Oh, my master, how sublime is this lesson of yours! 360 Oh, if I could be able to put it into practice as you teach me! Oh, || miserable me, never able to learn! Yes, I enjoy suffering, my Love, and I want to love much those who offend me and I feel much thrust to do so. If I could benefit I would do it but I understand this to be all your work because everything in me is imperfect. Only what you do in me is perfect. What greatness of a God!

361 How human beings live blinded! || My Good must lead me to convert them all. Oh, what a thought! Sometimes it occupies me because I go on thinking of the means to convert them and I pray, I rush, but I am so miserable that I am ashamed when I think of it.

What are you capable of doing, unworthy servant of the Lord, useless servant who is incapable of doing anything good! Oh, how many times I might have spoiled the field of your Work, my Good!

362 Though I find myself very || abandoned and see nothing except tribulations and sufferings before me, I do not lose peace deep in my conscience; I feel calm as if there was a balm that gave sweetness to the sufferings with the peace and calm of my conscience.

363 They say serious things against me but for God’s mercy not being aware of having done them with certainty, because what is done is always felt and one has knowledge of it. || But when I am not sure of having committed anything, I see more the nice inventions and deep in my heart I rejoice and am happy in the same slanders because when a creature feels very innocent she is happy to suffer for the love of Jesus and could say:

  • My Good, who is more innocent than you? Nobody in the world and yet you were slandered! || 364 Oh, sweet thought that sustains us, revives us and makes us love all the gossips and the slanders! I only feel the offence to God when the creature ill-treats her soul and undergoes punishment. My

God I forgive the one who offends me always.

A certain person wrote to my Protector Cardinal Al.a18 that I always searched for blessings, but they will never be equal to the cursing that she says every moment against me.

365 My Love, forgive her, || she does not know what she says, she is mad!

Perhaps it is a passion that makes her act like that; she hurts me because her soul suffers.

Oh, how I feel displeased and if I could be close to her and do some good, how I would do it!

366 I go on studying if I can benefit her in some way not with what she wants because it would be doing evil to the Work of the Lord but || to do good indirectly… In this I feel much happiness and consolation because I even fear that there could be much satisfaction and I must control myself so that no fears and anguishes may arise in me for having acted for my satisfaction. 367 Oh, how soon self gratification comes while it seems to me that I never accepted, no, but always to the limit || that pleases the Lord. My mind is always in him. It is never detached not even for a minute but everything that I do is in his presence.

368 First I question my Good and if I feel that it is his will that something may be, then soon I am there to carry out promptly what I felt pushed to do and with those feelings that are only his: peace, union, resignation and much pleasure in suffering. These || belong only to my Good. In this way I walk in peace and resignation because this is all the work of God.

“My Love, always with you, happy in sufferings as well as in consolation! 369 Since many times I am oppressed, if sometimes I am afraid of making mistakes regarding myself and I desire comfort, my Love forgive me and remember I am a poor slave unable of breathing without your || help. Eternal Father, have pity and mercy! Oh, if I obtain these…”

Intellectual vision of a beautiful rose

22 August. Today when I took time in the church meditation on the wound of his side, in this volcano of love I found greater thing than in the infinite abyss…

  • Oh, my Love – I could not avoid exclaiming – an inexhaustible treasure of graces, hiding-place of all my imperfections!

370 I tried to hide them all in him; later a very nice talk took my attention which I am || unable to write. In my intellect I saw a beautiful rose all in blossom with green leaves around but not many and with a beautiful well made stem of such freshness! As picked that moment it would last for centuries.

What would it mean? The talk continued and the rose gave scent because it was open; finally it delighted me.

371 As it ended I remained so conscious that I was no longer able to pray vocally because I wanted to recite the third part of the rosary || for the souls in purgatory but the beautiful rose was always before me. I never saw beauty like that! It seems it is still before me!

“My Love, always with you in struggle and in victory!”

After the hour of supper how much I suffered! It seemed that I was sick at every moment. I was feeling some kind of exhaustion that still now as I write, I feel as faint. My God, how you scourge me completely!

It is just like that because it seems that I have been scourged; the whole body || bends. How it pains!

372 I expect a terrible tribulation and I have the notice. What will it be, my God? When I will be in the battle as usual I will have strength, with the help of God and I will certainly win.

Who can lose while with you, my Good? Oh, no, always with you in the struggle and in the victory, my Love!

373 How painful it is to see a person who keeps some bitterness within herself and tries to pretend, but she is not able because she is not sincere. In her || apparent resignation she suffers, but if she could speak out what she keeps… Oh, how it could be much better if she could say everything even badly and give vent instead of keeping inside this kind of grudge which hurts the soul because it always sucks her moodiness and retires in herself and is irritated more. 374 She thinks of doing something but if she could do that with resignation, then certainly who is not || interiorly upset and grieved? No one. But happy and within herself she could feel some consolation. This is the true resignation which makes us advance on the way to perfection.

How sweet it is when this happens in us as a habit! One feels no more difficulty but feels comfort in resignation. 375 I said as a habit and without realizing one receives everything from the hands of dear Jesus. With holy indifference all the || pains pass; only this unfortunate of humanity never gives up, and if it were not for this one that feels and twists to be subjected, one would have no merit because the affliction would hardly be felt. Only those sufferings of the soul could molest us and make us suffer; the others could do nothing. Oh, these are truly painful!

376 In the dark and || walking gropingly, and with much pain for having lost you, how one suffers, my Love!

Oh, what pains, for our iniquities! There is no torture to which they could be compared. I feel that tonight I will suffer much because of the monster. Unfortunately this evening is one of those that it announces to me before they happen, because I already feel something, a certain fear and I would never lay down as if something would happen. 377 Only the person who experiences can understand what is felt || inside and all this without willing it.

Once I was strong and when this happened immediately I prayed, I disciplined myself… But now that I am very weak, what can I do? I must be happy for the little that I can do.

Sufferings for the offences against God, especially from the consecrated people

23 August. I was not mistaken; how the ugly beasts tormented me! 378 One was so big and it might have had more than fifteen big legs and some smaller ones. || It was as black as soot, enraged, it almost struggled with itself. Oh, how I felt pain for it! It left me much fear and fright. What will happen? Oh, all the carnival of devils is in Piacenza! This was its direction! Let us wait until the time draws near and in this way we will see what this beast has plotted. 379 Only the offence against God gives me pain; this I feel too much. There is no comparison for the suffering || it causes me and the pain it brings because of the offence done to God.

How can I avoid this? And yet, they are good people and consecrated. How this monster makes the creatures blind, it shows them one thing for another and at the end they believe. Meanwhile deluded like these, where do they finish?

If I could find a sacrifice that could be offered to avoid many injuries that your most sweet heart receives, my Good, what I would not do! ||

Fire of love with swelling on the side of her heart

380 Date 25 and 26 August. I thought I would die by the fire

I had on my side; the ribs were raised to a point that I had to loosen myself though I had a night dress only, and I tried to keep up the waist of the dress rather than suffer!

In this way the next day, on twenty-five August, I was still swollen and again at the same hour. It stayed for the whole day; what a fire! And my side again today… twenty-seven, I am swollen and only seeing it makes me fear, though I try some means || not to see, it is useless. 381 It is very visible now.

For a long time it did not happen. I run to my daughter Sisters

Anne del Salvatore and at last now I have a bit of respite. Last night I saw a blue star which means it is a lay person who will die but it was very big and it left me much pain.

In the same way after lunch, I went to the church. I was tired and wanted to pray and not being able to do it vocally

I placed myself on the side of Jesus and tried to find rest in him. 382 While I was like this, there was a || procession – so to say – of faces one after the other. There was one with a moustache and a big head and sisters of other Institutes and not of ours but all well in order; they were all portraits that I seemed to have known but I was not able to distinguish though I felt much pain. For all the time that I remained like this, when one ended another one came and I was always embracing my Good. 383 Oh, how sweet it is to rest in || him!

Answers received from Sister Anne del Salvatore

At the end of this passage I came to my senses and I did not enjoy that union anymore; then I asked the dear Sister Anne del Salvatore to tell me when a certain person who was awaited will come. She answered:

  • On Monday.

In the same way for other things which I asked her this morning; I asked when I will obtain a grace and she answered me – now I cannot remember the sentence – that it was already granted. I was only to receive communication.

  • 384 And the other one? – I asked. ||

  • Even this is granted but it will be communicated to you after the third grace.

For years I have asked her and for this she said that there was nothing yet, that I would have this but it needed much more time.

This was what I understood, that I would have this but with time and she made me feel how this will be done, so to say, and she did not posses it yet. Oh, how ordered, and how sweet is my Love everything that belongs to you!

I asked for other things and I was answered in everything. 385 How she comforted me! ||

“My fiber is strong because it is that of Jesus”

I do not dwell on the sufferings of these days because even to me it seems strange to suffer so much and to be able to stand and work. Furthermore when it is very strong I feel faint and when it seems it will take place I hold tightly where I am and with acts of contrition and of love I entrust myself to God.

Oh, how I suffer because soon this humanity is disheartened and would like to overcome receiving comforts.

386 Absolutely not. Then I stand firm and I need to force myself so painfully || that without my Good I could not bear it.

There was a person who said she had strength to carry on much work. Oh, how I laughed within me!

Certainly even a skeleton could be able to resist and to do even more if you want it, my God!

Within myself I said:

  • Yes, my fiber is strong because it is that of Jesus! It is certainly that!

Oh, if it was only my strength I could not lift an arm but with the strength of my Good… || Oh, my poor ass! 387 I cannot number the times in which I was given the oil of the sick and I received the blessing in ‘articulo mortis’ the point of death and they were all sicknesses of a grave nature.

Oh, my Love, great things are done with your strength!

What a consolation I had to see someone who had thought of killing himself and today I was assured that the Blessed Virgin had foiled everything in that brain! 388 He will live as a good Christian and I am sure that with the help of God and of the Blessed Virgin, he will live and die as a || true

Catholic.

These are consolations that cannot be explained; because only to the person who loves God is given to feel them, in the same way as one feels the offence done to the sweet Love. Oh, in that moment the pain is so strong that one cannot avoid weeping and praying. One would like to amend and find the means to be able to stop it, always anxious to be able to stop and drive away the monster of sin. 389 How || I feel tortured when I think that I offended him more than all. Oh, what love what mercy without compare!

“Always embracing my Good, I will win in everything”

I feel faint at the sight of a tribulation that is to cause damage to the poor Institute! It is so turbulent – if this expression can be used – that it brings an indisposition and I am always as someone who awaits news that unfortunately she knows already they are sad.

My Love, defend your Work, I am one of the most miserable creatures; I am capable of nothing, a null being.

390 My Good || will make everything right. I do not understand how but I am sure he will remedy everything.

I do not even know how this suffering in me, the thought that I will feel the whole event, gives me much pain, and yet as I said above, at the end I do not know what my ears will hear but I am sure that my Good will take care of everything.

391 Yes, it is of much relief, but I cannot take away such a great impression. Only you, my Good… ||

I understand that when I will be right, then everything will calm down in me and I will have nothing. You in everything my Love, and nothing more!

How the ugly, filthy devil tried to upset me telling me that what happened signified what I expected. 392 Imagine the foolishness of a sister who did not want to be persuaded that I was in the room. Instead she wanted me to be sick; foolishness. Immediately || the devil said:

  • This was what was to happen to you!

Oh, how it is possible! What my Good had promised me will never fail. Oh, how I still hear whispers! It always whispers, and in all the opportunities finds the means of disturbing me. But not, it will not make it and I will always be tightly holding my Good and I will win in everything.

393 In the meditation I had much concentration; but I tried not to reach to that point in which || my side… Oh, what I felt! If it does not catch me suddenly I try to think on the passion but not with union because much… I would not like 394 to be put off but at the thought that I must be in the church and that my side suffers more, I abstain. Thinking like this I seem to be doing the will of God who many times made me understand that his Work comes before anything else since he is the one || who acts in me.

Signs of people who die, anxiety and suggestions

29 August. Last night while I rested I understood that I would have a terrible night and that it was. It would need much to describe what I had the whole night!

Sisters of another Institute, other people, all announced to me their departure towards eternity; in this way I passed the night awake. At one I thought of starting the meditation and I continued it until half past four. After, tired, I recited with difficulty the litanies of the Lord and I remained halfasleep until the rising hour. || 395 But how can I describe the exhaustion of strength? I had no breath. This is how I passed the whole day.

After Lunch, in the church, a Crucifix appeared to me, but I feared that it may really be my Good; it was black, and while within me I said: - How is it so black? It disappeared.

After I felt nothing, or rather soon I felt fear; certainly he was not the one. But!

396 I saw another group (I express myself this way having no other term) of people together || whom I could not distinguish well. Even these were black and their scheming was seen from their way of acting. I will see. It is certain that I will soon have an explanation of what will happen.

Certainly the enemy has no respite; it always tries to bring pains and upsets the peace and this is its principal action; it puts turmoil in everything.

Oh, how I expect always to see in some way to be able to understand. 397 Oh, my Love, || only you could keep it chained and when it has some freedom, how it takes advantage!

I never thought it was a cowardly subject, prisoner of his Majesty, most peaceful, divine, powerful whom the filthy one forgets.

Oh, Blessed Virgin, you who crushed its head with a foot, pray for the sinners and the worst of all the creatures who live only for Jesus! Amen.

29 August 1890.

MS 11. 3 – 12

Symbolic vision about the value of a consecrated soul

1 10 November 1890. I saw two devils of immense size and they were debating between themselves in a frightening way.

  • Why this? I questioned in my mind.

One of them answered:

  • Because I lost many souls and this one fewer!

At a certain moment they stopped and one showed me an infinite number of souls that it captured; on the other side there were only a small number.

2 One of these few souls came in front, an angel came and stayed on the side of the soul asking the monster the value of || that soul. – She was a religious – it never finished giving him souls to reach to the value of that soul. What a scene! He has to give almost all, no one remained anymore. This costs much to my Lord! Oh, how I remained!

Everything disappeared and I was unable to understand those words of an angel. I give a hint but if I had to write the details of what I felt…

It was a weaving of beautiful things.

Special graces on the feast of the Immaculate

12 December. 3 In the novena of the Blessed Virgin Immaculate, I promised the Virgin to do the discipline until bleeding for the whole of the novena for the conversion || of a sinner and I did much the last evening. It was so strong that I lost much blood; perhaps for a small vein that was pricked and did not clot.

I wanted a word from the Blessed Virgin, that he would be converted. But it might need longer time. That was what I got interiorly.

On the fourth day I had a very beautiful light and the event was being carried out clearly. I was not in myself but transported in contemplation, I saw what homage the queen of heaven received. Oh, how beautiful she was! The whole paradise with various mansions presented tribute to her.

4 As I recovered I started to write in order to have the things clear, but || in the middle I was called persistently and I had to leave. I did not find time to take it again and today I will finish. Always an insisting voice said to me – write!

I was tired and I answered:

  • How could I do it if you do not give me an hour of time! Sane and fortified in my head I will write at night, as

I did in the past or a bit of respite in the affairs; otherwise I suppose this to be a diabolic act.

One could not believe how today I set in order and wrote almost without realizing it. When there is time I carry out the obedience || immediately.

5 The day of the Immaculate, how I passed it! I felt sweet its nearing, I pleaded her for the grace, I offered to her the sacrifice of the person whose conversion I asked but she always answered to me:

  • I will take care.

My Love, Mary, sweetest Mother, say yes to me!

I had a short speech on the Immaculate, but short because I was feeling that my side was united and exulted as if those words carried me to the union; I searched for another theme.

6 It was a very happy day but the following day, I had a bit of fever that I carried for eight days. || I always felt the idea that it was rheumatism. That is also how the doctor judged it, hearing that I had pain, but it was the exhaustion of strength for the blood that I lost during the discipline. Forcing myself cost me much.

Oh, suffering is sweet!

Vision of the Crucified who laid his hands on her head

16 December. I saw a badly battered Crucifix that had a big black sign on the right side of the front. It seemed it wanted me to say: let us give it away!

But while I was saying this it made a sign of no, many times and strongly. At this sight – Oh, no! - I said – I will ask that it may be cleaned and after I will always keep it with me. 7 I came closer || praying him to lay his hands on my head and I went nearer. He brought his hands together and laid them on my head.

Oh, my sweet Love, what I felt!

That was not enough. A person came near the bed where there was a big basket of stuff: fruits… He turned and said:

  • Here is the providence.

I removed from the basket and seeing that it started to diminish I spread my hand signing it three times:

  • Let it multiply always and never finish!

The Crucified answered.

  • It will always be like this.

8 Oh, what an impression I had || from these words! It seemed to me that I had done wrong so I asked him to forgive me; and again he put his most blessed hands on my head and I moved.

The next day I narrated it as a dream and it was very clear before me in its details that cannot be kept for a long time.

Graces she received in the novena of Christmas

23 December. I was lying down and I wanted to sleep so that I could feel better. But not; 9 in this way praying with open eyes I saw nearing a crown which seemed of fire. || I say crown because it was circular and I felt a dread because a span higher than this, in a way that it could hit the crown, there was a flash of fire, similar to the flashes which are seen when there is a thunder-storm. This fell down. Oh, what a pain!

I asked but I had no reply; perhaps a ruler? Nothing. It will be seen.

I was able to do few penances in the novena and also on the eve except for the chain which I never removed and only on the eve I disciplined myself until bleeding and also did my fasting. 10 For the remaining I had to resign myself but I had a bit of comfort || of an obedience so much taken in air but which cost me much for having said something small.

In this period in which I was not able to write, the beasts tormented me constantly. How many things they did to me!

But how many times my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore comforted me!

In me everything continued as in the past; the tribulations were increasing and of a sensible type, but my Good gave me much strength and I bore them always with resignation and peace, welcoming them from the most holy hands of God. ||

11 I battled much for some decisions that I had to take but my Good did not delay to come to my help and he instructed me what I should do. ||

It was a day of much suffering for the Foundress: according to her they are the intrigues of the evil one.

MS 12.1 – pp. 1-14

Mother Rosa started the New Year with deadly presages; she experienced a new kind of sufferings. After January 12 the diary was interrupted; her work did not allow her to write. She had to go to Piacenza to assist her son Alessandro who was gravely sick, and she was consoled to see him die with the best spiritual dispositions on March 16.

Night anxieties, ghosts and signs of bad events returned. At the beginning of July she made an interesting reflection on the meaning of Memorie which she wrote with repugnance as if dictated and she asked: “What would my God want from these writings of his or rather this dictation of him?”

She welcomed with exultation the appointment of Verga to be the Protector of the Institute, as she had lively desired. She often expressed her joy for the Good service that this Cardinal gave to the Daughters of St. Anne. Later on everything will change for the reasons that the Servant of God foresaw.

New struggles made her more united to the one who is the true guide of the Institute; she knows that with him victory is sure. In order to obtain the necessary help and to give thanks for the gifts she received from God she found no better means than to run to the penances. But she was not able to continue for long in bodily punishment. In fact in the month of October the chain that she carried tightly in her body for more than fifteen years had penetrated the flesh in a dangerous way.

On October 26 she saw before her a beautiful basket 12 of flowers, a notice of new sufferings which come without delay whether interior or exterior. On November 11 she wrote: “How badly reduced is my ass! But it is like this for my Good!” Many times she felt alone, without someone to whom to turn for important decisions. But she felt helped by Jesus in her instructions to the sisters and to the novices.

On November 28 she gave an explanation of the localized pain on one point of her head: it was a particular participation in the crown of thorns of the Lord.

Worrying presages for the new year. New kind of pains

1 January 1891. My God, if all the uproar I saw this night will come true what a terrible year it will be! May God, my Lord and Master, give me the grace to bear everything in peace and resignation and instruct me to accomplish perfectly his divine will.

A black beast persecuted me: dead, sick all were here in this night of the first of the year! 13 Let everything be for my God!

10 January. How can I describe my pains? They are so many and all of new kinds, never expected || and very sensitive because they come from people who are very close. Patience!

The worst thing for me is to see myself alone, without a word of comfort and not knowing what I should do. It is true that my Master in this seems to make me understand sufficiently what clearly he wants me to do. But I have a certain fear, though I must say it does not seem to be a diabolic act, but I find myself not less combated but resigned to the divine will. As a poor exile I stay in this valley of || tears.

Ecstasy after Communion

14 12 January. This morning, after receiving Holy Communion I do not know what I did but I remained absorbed and I was shaken when the priest was on the last oremus of the Mass.

  • Is it finished – I went on repeating – and how?

Oh, my sweet love, how time is reduced to a flash, it escapes! How many things he left me with! My intellect full of knowledge, and among many one which grieved me much concerned a sister; he showed me what she thought interiorly…

15 I benefited her much || and then? I do not want to say more…

Today I received the news of the death of a lady whom

I saw long ago and I did not understand. Oh, poor soul she asked for prayers!

At the bedside of her son Alessandro

6 May. In all these past months I was not able to find time to write; the activity of the Work kept me the whole day. In January I suffered much and I had to struggle much with this miserable humanity, with the enemy of hell.

I was in Piacenza because my son was very grave. One evening in which I suffered much and I lay in bed praying

Jesus the “Ecce homo” appeared to me; he was very beautiful but suffering in an extraordinary way. 16 He had no hair || tied on the neck; no, it was folded on the forehead and the whole head the same. It was something sorrowful.

  • My God! – I exclaimed.

He had crossed hands as the “Ecce homo.”

Alas! His vice said to me:

  • This is how your son will be reduced!

I cannot express what sorrow I felt. I tried to take courage but inside me I was feeling a strength that destroyed me with pain. Therefore this poor creature will not die until he will be reduced this way. Oh, pains!

17 After a few days he took the same || portrait: all the hair on the forehead, folded and wet with sweat. He had no wounds yet but even these did not delay to come.

At the end of February I was at the bedside of my son and I prayed; St. Joseph appeared to me and said words that I was unable to understand well. Did he come to take him? During the day I did not understand him and I thought that it would be the first day of this month. Instead it was the first day of the triduum of his feast on 19 March. Oh, how much I suffered for the violence of resisting until the end! Oh, what a fight! It was atrocious. My breast was breaking and I did not want to give vent || with tears, no! Oh, I agonized!

18 Another day he was speaking to me… that he had certain pains. While he said this I saw an ugly monster that passed near his bed.

Oh, how – I thought within me – now how his pains will disturb him! No, I made the holy cross and before he reconciled again it could do nothing. It did not even appear anymore and he remained always calm.1

Sufferings of every kind

The sufferings that the enemy made me experience! It gave vent against the Work of the Lord and how much it did! 19 Horrible things happened || because it tempted the sisters with pride; I leave the details because I have placed everything in the hands of God praying him to drive away the dragon of hell and to give peace to his poor brides.2

How much I suffered during the Holy Week! Especially on Friday the pains were more than in other years. Yes, I had them for some time but very strongly in feeling the union of my side with my Good. Oh, how I was happy in that spasm! 20 I did not feel it for a long time; I was informed that it || would have been repeated since I have to work and it was not yet time to have them very strong…

Oh, my Love, what a deprivation! I do not speak of the beasts, of the signs which these monsters give me continuously because I cannot even number them. They always continue in different but fearful ways; the more they try to hide the facts the more they are understood because they leave one form and they take another that better declares the meaning.

Presage of epidemic. Consolation in writing

21 13 May. How can I write many things || that have passed!

I will leave and I will only say what I had some few days ago.

I saw signs of an epidemic and last evening they were more horrible than ever, so much so that I was not able to sleep because of the unrest. My God, have mercy on the poor sinners and most of all on your poor slave who is the most sinful of all the sinners.

Date 25 May. I was very bad but after much suffering from a headache and another strong pain, I was lying down and the pain diminished much. A sight of a grave epidemic upset me and it was already the second time.

22 This last || would have brought less havoc than the first which was towards Spain and the other side of Egypt, if I am not mistaken. This third one could be in southern Italy.

I see the Blessed Virgin so sad, such that only looking at her

I feel the melancholy of death and I am always fearful. 24 Oh, my sweet Love, what greater delight could there be if not that of doing your most holy will! ||

Signs and various presages

10 June. 29 The night before I saw a black soul, then a very ugly and fierce beast that showed me of having won because in its clutches it held a quantity || of objects together. With these it also showed me that it had also won a soul. Oh, how it frightened me! I shouted so much, my God! Finally it ran away and disappeared. I cannot describe how it left me; I had an unrest that took away my sleep and more so it upset me so much that I had difficulty to pray. Oh, what could it be!

“Here I am in a stormy sea tossed by the waves”

22 June. This night was terrible; how many beasts and how many tricks they did! One picked a quarrel to hurt the other; finally it was something odd and at the same time painful because they showed me they put in disorder a very large house and that they would bring much sorrow to a group of sisters with their superior. Oh, hateful dragon!

Every night upset by the sight of many “black souls”

2 July. How many black souls! Even during daytime they come to torment me! Unfortunate creatures, if they could see how they reduce their souls they would not do it! What should I do? Pray? I am afraid they are already dead and certainly I do not pray because their fate is determined. There is no more hope. What a pain! I would like to pray, to plead my God but for the fear that they may already be where hope is dead I do || not do it.

33 The fear that they make me feel from their noises is of greater pain because they frighten me. I am almost asleep and these with much uproar now on one side and now on the other wake me.

What will I say of the other sufferings? It seems to me really boring to repeat that I live always in torments. The thought that the sufferings please Jesus is sweet and this sweetness certainly encourages us to desire to suffer more. 34 May God give me to be completely || consumed for him. How many things I had these days especially of communications with my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore! Oh, I truly say that she is my comfort!

Now, she told me that M.T. will die. I would like that she tells me if it will be when he will be traveling, but on this she said nothing. I asked for the conversion of a sinner and she did not even say: - Not at all.

Oh, how her word is sure! I would have much to say.

“Oh, what would my God want from these writings or rather dictations of his?”

35 I do not understand. It is a long time that everything I do must be done with much || repugnance || and when I understand that my God wants this I am soon at work but with much difficulty, as when I had to write certain things.

In truth I must say that I do not understand what I write and in order to know what I write I must reread and pause.

  • Is it me who wrote this? – I ask – Oh, what will my

“Cardinal Verga will be our Protector”

Today my side was united with my Beloved in the same way || as on the last days the union was strong. 38 Today I was tightly united with my Beloved when Cardinal Verga arrived. I did not know what to do and what to say; I needed much firmness not to say anything, but I realized well that I did not say everything well.

Oh, my Love, this will be our Protector. He will love the Work!

My enemy tries everything though it is unable to, but the power of my God will triumph and this ugly devil will remain humiliated. 39 In what pain it || kept me and how it tried to bring evil to the Work of the Lord while it never profited.

Oh, my Master, Being of my life, as always you work with me and you make this slave of yours speak! Oh, I see very clearly that you are my life! Who gave me strength to bear this chain which I carried for fifteen years? Now as I swell it enters my flesh which decomposes; the swelling ceases and luckily it heals. What goodness of my God, Love without compare, Beloved of my soul!

Oh, what pain it gives me! Well, should I write it? The pain ceases and does not even disturb me except that the arm swells and nothing more.

Oh, my Love, if you are my life nothing bothers me because you heal me and you cause me sores in the body as you wish! I am always happy when I suffer for you, my Good. || 41 Always tightly holding your feet, my Love, I find no more difficulty to do any sacrifice!

8 July. In the evening what my daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore had assured me to happen, that our Protector would be His Eminence Cardinal Verga, became true. Oh, it was a real relief for me!

Now I asked her if a person will be healed and will do the work that she/he desired for long. She answered me that the person will not do it and will also die. 42 Now certainly what she said will happen. Oh, if I could write || what she tells me I would have to write much because I question her in everything.

Oh, may God bless you, and for me, good soul, give thanks to the Lord for having granted me much grace!

I am very troubled by anguish especially to see a person who is very attached to her health.

Oh, what pain I feel, my God!

Ghosts and night fears

14 July. For some days there has been a strong shaking that woke me. What did I see? 43 A new epidemic and I cried as if it was near: - will I die? ||

But as soon as I woke well, I looked to the terrible signs but I felt no fear, because that was all by my God. Thinking of the fact that I cried I understood it was all an effect of the humanity that reasoned for its advantage and the smallest things frightened it.

44 In this way, speaking with a person I gave a very frank speech on what she/he could have done for the Work of the Lord and if I could have thought at the manner of saying, it would have been || difficult to achieve it. But when my Good wants something for his Institute he speaks through this slave of his without even herself knowing what she said.

Even now I had obtained something very beautiful to make a person become completely for her/his Institute.

At least if they could be in || the air, but touching 46 me… My Jesus, do not allow them!

The earlier night I saw a long soul of a woman and it was so thin, and worn out; it crossed my bed from the feet.

I could not avoid screaming because as soon as I woke up I was not in control of myself and in this way I screamed immediately. Luckily in the room I am far away. Otherwise, I would really disturb them.

Within me I said: - What would the Holy Mother want?

I was about to say something but I was soon upset: what would be? She was neither cheerful nor sad; the whole morning I kept her before my eyes and I always went on thinking: - What would she want? What will happen?

48 My God, Blessed Virgin, my Mother St. Anne, how many tribulations I have had || in these days and new ones are continuing; I feel so prostrate and I have no strength to stand on my feet, I always feel faint. My Good, Being of my life, may everything be for your greater pleasure.
