  • I will respect the promise with much strength; I will pour out until the last drop of blood if this will please my God.

I remained calm on this side, not giving up other usual and new penances, always painful and tormenting. 68 How it roars || when I promise and go around my cell with the cross on my shoulders! How it roars! For this reason it studies new astute ways to torment me. I feel I have not enough strength to discipline myself until bleeding.

Today I was very worn out. The cross on the breast and again putting it on the shoulders and moving around was very heavy; the same was for the discipline until bleeding. I felt like a rag!

The hand is trembling and tomorrow God willing I will write. 69 I feel something painful so deep that it exhausts me of strength such that I cannot stand on my feet; || a pain which I find difficult to describe. I feel the whole mind upside down and I understand that there is something painful in the air.

If this pleases my God, I feel much satisfaction to be able to undergo this suffering to satisfy the divine majesty.

My Love, I will always be happy to carry beatings for your love!

70 To see many creatures who have much pretence seems to me something painful for my God who loves sincerity of heart and who is for us a help; he is ready to || help us in everything. What unfaithfulness, my Love.

Alarm caused by the chain that entered in her flesh

24 October 1891. After three days of painful sickness today I woke up a bit. Though I could stand very little, I was able to work with the help of God. I take this half an hour to write these few memoirs.

71 The chain which I carry from long ago often enters into my flesh and taking it out always removes pieces of flesh. I had always infection, first one side and then on the other side. I was taken by || atrocious pain that I thought was the sickness that always arises again and later ceases; this was what I did: I applied the vesicant, but I did not know how it reached the chain. Wounds were added in pulling out the vesicant. Oh, my God! The pain spread and it was so strong that it made me completely numb; I was no longer able to move.

What could I do? 72 My Love, have pity on me, now they will realize! || No, no, my Love! And I wept. I dragged myself so that I was able to put on the woolen dress and I threw myself on the bed; the pain increased and it was so much that it gave me cruel shocks; it lifted me and I remained breathless.

  • My God – I said – could this be tetanus? From the shocks it could be tetanus, but I do not know!

The poor secretaries whom I called were frightened; the chain had entered into the wound produced by the vesicant. What could I do? How could I remove it if I was || motionless?

73 I pleaded with my Good that he may have charity that the chain could open and I could remove it after fifteen years and more of not removing it.

The arms were freed from pain. As soon as these were movable I removed the chain; what a pain! How can I qualify it? It was an agony of death.

I wanted to receive Communion because I feared much.

74 Today in taking it to put it on again, I had to clean it first. What I felt to see how much || dry flesh and blood had filled the openings of the chain. It seemed like an iron without holes. What will happen when I put it on once again? I feel some kind of fear, but will removing it be God’s will?

My Good I am alone wrapped in a very deep melancholy and I would like that nobody could realize my torture. Oh, cruel state! Only weeping at your feet, my dear Crucifix, is my comfort. Mine is hard slavery: || have pity on your slave, my Love!

75 Even the terrible enemy takes advantage of my state in order to put in my ears horrible whispers. It is difficult to be freed; one must be satisfied to be very watchful so that it might not really enter. What pains are these my Love?

“God gave us a holy and wise Protector in the person of Cardinal Verga”

Today reading or rather I heard from the secretary the reading of a paper where an epidemic was clearly described in two places and it slaughtered people. 76 It has really come. Oh, I feel pain || for the poor! It is a kind of cholera and they are destroyed by much dysentery and bleeding. Poor people they are without relief!

The beasts continue to pass but are small and without a tail. But these days I had sights of certain drawbacks little ordered and I suffered much.

Wherever I turned I saw nothing but terrible ghosts. 77 Oh, what horrible deformed faces and they leave me with unrest that with the effort I cannot explain. If I || try to investigate, because that is how it happens, it is worse! I am given to think little or nothing; I even try to distract myself so that I am not worried.

My Good, when will this painful state come to an end?

When my God is deigned to pour on this poor slave of his the grace to be fully according to his will and to fulfill perfectly in everything his divine will. Out of grace everything can be gained. 78 Oh, how I desire to destroy || completely myself for the beloved and my sweet Love! To see how miraculously he supports and directs his Work of St.

Anne… Now he gave us a Protector who is holy and wise, in the person of His eminence Cardinal Verga. Oh, the dear

Salvatore was right in telling me repeatedly when I was in the antechamber of the Cardinal of the State to ask him for a

Protector that Verga will be the one and he could have done much good to the Institute, but they had already said no. 79 I said: ||

  • How could this be, if the Holy Father had already said no?

She replied:

  • He will be the one.

While I prepared myself to ask the Cardinal of State, she repeated that Verga will be the one. That was what happened.

The same Cardinal of State willingly accepted but at a condition that he himself would have spoken to the Holy

Father so that he can confirm his Eminence Cardinal Verga.

Everything happened as this creature had said; it was Verga and had already given proof of continued protection and defense giving much help to the Work of God. || 80 Finally he is the first and our only defender, protector and father. Oh, how much the Work is grateful! He will be eternally remembered for his help!

May the Lord keep him and pour on him the choicest of his graces. The consolidation of the Work of God is clearly seen and the perfection in fast steps!

Everything is your work, my God. I have nothing but the annihilation and my nothingness stands out in your great work. ||

Pius IX, true “founder” and Protector of the Institute

81 This morning while I meditated, something supernatural caught me which I cannot express.

In this union or trance which I am unable to describe well, I saw clearly the Holy Mother St. Anne who prayed to the Saviour insistently. At the end he answered her:

  • You will have everything you asked me for.

How I was consoled! I felt much sweetness and certainty of obtaining everything through the dear Mother St. Anne. Oh, how I feel loving her || passionately! I would like to make her loved by the whole world. 82 What power she has on the throne of God! Jesus refuses her nothing and infinite times I could describe so many graces that Jesus granted for her Work through her intercession and that of Pius IX.

Oh, how he prays, because he is the founder! Because if he would not order me for obedience and made the prophecy that it will spread quickly as the flight of a || dove in all parts of the world…

83 How I have proof of his continued help is something great! Every time that something bad happens on the side of the administration as well as from the sisters, soon I run to my father praying him to go to that house and to put right everything not allowing evil to take place. 84 At the end of my prayer, how calm I feel! I tell him || everything and then I ask him to bring a remedy to that disorder and make of the sisters models of observance. If the controversies are from the administration, that he may calm those people and that they may grant us what we are in need of; from lions he may convert them to meek lambs. Oh, how I always obtain this!

  • You see, my father – I say – I cannot go ahead. My sickness does not allow me to do so anymore. 85 Do my part, go to that house and put it right! ||

I am sure that miraculously it is like this.

Oh, my Holy father, for the obedience that I always gave you, pray for me so that I may do in everything the most holy will of God and that this may always be my treasure!

86 Today I had the news of a house abroad which was placed under the protection of Pius IX; miraculously he has provided for it two good missionary friars and they are happy. That mission was a desperate case because other missionaries had left and the sisters were || without a confessor and nobody wanted to go there. My God, what did I do? I prayed to my father, that he may take care of that house where his daughters do much good and he may make in a way that they may have missionaries. He did not delay to grant that grace. The missionaries went soon and also without payment. How they reached there I do not know;

only the Lord would have brought them there. What a miracle!

87 Oh, my father, yes, the Blessed Virgin || will lift you up on the altar, with her power she will give a beginning to your cause. Oh, if I could tell about the continuous graces that he does in the Work of the Lord!

I would like to describe one of the many graces which I always see with open eyes at every step. When I am in conversation with certain good souls who tell me that the graces that my Good grants them, how happy I feel!

88 I think that these creatures knew how to prepare their hearts well to receive them. Oh, in which mud || I realize I am and how I would like to fall to pieces in order to destroy what is found in me which does not please my Good! Oh, what a desire I feel and if I could find only one fiber which does not belong to my Love, I would tear it.

A beautiful basket of flowers of a dead color, notice of suffering

26 October. What a horrible night of tormenting anguish I spent! At two o’clock after midnight something shook me. As usual I opened my eyes very upset and what did I see? 89 A very beautiful big basket || of flowers of dead color.

The roses were very clear, some were white and some pink but even these were pale. A trembling seized me! My

God, should I go through the whole of this basket of sufferings? Because every time I had a vision like this I was sure of having many torments to pass through.

Taking away my sleep, a convulsion remained in me because this miserable humanity has a good remembrance of other facts.

They will be dead? And who? My God, how I suffer! 90 The sad thought || that occupied me was something painful and in this way I spent the whole night. Today still remembering it how oppressed I felt by a horrible sadness. Within me I go on saying:

  • But how, such beautiful and gracious flowers, why should I think of such foolishness?

But the depression is not mine. It was left by the sight; before I thought of the meaning I already felt || very fierce pain.

91 Immediately interiorly I was upside down. In this way with these other circumstances with similar signs, what power the enemy had to torment me came to my mind. What remained in me was curious; I am so afraid that I do not move out of fear and I do not know the reason. I seem stupid at every moment. 92 From what it can come I do not understand. || Tightly holding my Crucifix I say:

My Love, do not leave me because I feel I am dying.

“How changeable human beings are …

My God is the only unchangeable!”

27 October. My presage did not delay to become true. Today was a very sad day because the devil was fierce with a quantity of accusations that I do not know how the enemy came up always with new pretexts to make war. 93 A very fierce enemy of the Work of the Lord, it always tries to put obstacles in its speedy journey so that it may halt. No, it will run and || in the mercy of God it is written:

  • No one could touch the hair of my Work.

This is how calm I am; how many persecutors and how they want to oppress me! Perhaps they do it in good faith but I cannot say that I do not suffer. Oh, how I feel these pains!

94 Before I was depressed and I wept bitterly; now I feel it much but with indifference: what could be done or not done does not depend on me, my Good. They want it like this, and what should I do? My head || is consumed for your Work and I am still ready for new sacrifices and sufferings. But do you see, they stop me, what should I do?

You well know that I am not able to find a way out in order to obtain explanations for everything. When the superiors speak, my fear of not obeying blindly is such that the smallest thing frightens me. Therefore, my Love take care.

95 This evening while I prayed in the church, I felt so relieved || and it was the sight of my Alessandro who told me these words:

  • Poor mother, be consoled, that these pains will finish quickly.

And he disappeared. I entrusted myself to my Sister

Anne del Salvatore and she comforted me assuring me that my sufferings were pleasing to God. Oh, this is enough!

For me they are not sufferings but treasures pleasing my Good. 96 How changeable human beings are! One day it lifts you up and relieves the sufferings; another day it || throws you in the precipice and becomes an accomplice of the oppressing. Only my God is unchangeable!

In this way detached from everything, I do not find a thought that makes me desire even the smallest thing. I find pleasure in nothing, only in my God and all my delights are only in him.

“How badly reduced, you are my donkey!

But it is like this for my Good”

11 November. 97 I am horribly molested by the visits of diabolic monsters which under different shapes come to frighten me tormenting me in such a way that I cannot sleep. || They leave me with horrible trembling as if the nerves twisted. Last evening one of them left me with a different impression of what will happen: it is something horrible. In the morning I am so weak that I cannot stand on my feet; what I suffer in my head I cannot describe because it swells out of pain, first on one side and then on the other side. I cannot be busy and I struggle to work; many times I cannot even be busy. Oh, how worn out my nerves feel! 98 The smallest thing disconcerts me and || depresses me while in the past I bore these sufferings very well. When what the beasts with their sight have made me feel came to be reality and the fact arrived, I was feeling nothing. Now even if I am prepared and I expect it, I feel it very much.

  • How badly reduced, you are my ass! – I say – but it is like this for my Good.

It seems to me boring to describe my state of actual pains. I only say that I suffer without any || comfort.

Alone, afflicted in a state of complete abandonment

99 14 November 1891. This night I had other novelty to see and to hear concerning the beasts and the torments that they try to cause me. Finally I was angry with them and wanted to rest; what did they do? They crawled on the ground and black shadows rolled near the bed. No, I despised them more than ever; at the end they kept quiet and I slept. 100 The fact of not wanting to allow the beasts to stay in the room remained very fixed in my mind and || I dreamt “the thousand day-dreaming.” I was oppressed. Oh, ugly animal that torments me even in the little sleep that I take!

It is odd that a good soul who gave a big house and revenue to the Daughters of St. Anne, every time there is something that disturbed in the Work she did, and it did not go well. She always came and presented herself sad. 101 This night she noticed me that only one part was doing well and these were the schools, but || not the service, and the superior took much from the salary.

That left me much pain because I thought:

  • What will I do to put right that affair?

What a torture it is for me! I cannot sleep and I have such an anxiety that I was badly reduced. How odd it was! After being angry against that monster, it came to disturb me saying:

  • You have changed!

My God, it was not like that! 102 But I changed for having strongly reproached so that the ugly monster || may leave me to rest because for many nights I was not able to sleep. In this way in the morning I had a headache and more so I remained very sick and I was unable to work. If I did that it was with much difficulty and I suffered much. But my Good did not delay to assure me that there was nothing bad and that I had even done well to treat that filthy dragon harshly.

103 Oh, my Love, || how from morning to evening this astute snake is devoured with rage for not being able to win and I always hope to bring victory with your help, my God!

Alone and so afflicted, I feel I am in a state of complete abandonment; though I am a mistress, out of experience I am not able to adapt myself not to have a word that could help to understand what I should do and what could help to lift me up. 104 Oh, the sufferings are always new, even if repeated a thousand times; the torturous melancholy is produced || by having lost the Being of my life. I do not feel him anymore, I do not see him; gropingly I climb with my mind to find a way of finding him. I only feel annoyance with the penances and so foolishly I do not care. I want my Good and nothing more.

Everything oppresses me; I do not let others realize it but I struggle not to show how much repugnance I feel toward every created thing. What helps me to overcome is the thought that this and everything is the work of my || God.

105 Oh, answer me, my Good. Have pity on me! May my weeping, my suffering, appease your justice and tell me that I am yours again, my God!

An inspired conference to the novices

16 November. I am always anxious and I feel that the worst will come; the monster does all kinds of evil and tries to molest me in everything.

Yesterday an interior voice exhorted me to prepare a conference for the novices and the fear of not being able to say anything gave me a terrible pain. There was no way of putting an ordered thought in my mind; but || what will I say?

106 I would have liked to push it aside and not do it; then the fear of not obeying my God caught me. With this struggle I climbed to the novitiate. I trembled and I was confused because it seemed impossible to say even a word. When I started about the grace of vocation and how this is little considered etc. 107 Oh, how I felt lifted seeing that words came out of my mouth. As ignorant as I am, I would have never guessed || that I’d speak so coherently even if I could have studied for a year. What I got can be easily understood; it seemed to me to be nothing. I was careful not to give myself the minimum relief. I would have liked to retire, thank my God and have a bit of peace, but I had to listen to a person who waited for me.

“Oh, how painful it is to be always alone in making decisions!”

108 Well, without feeling the least pain I consented. Nothing was difficult for me even when I had to do it against my will; || it is even a pleasure for me and a bit of relief for my poor state that is very painful.

Every time I try to say a word not of what I feel but regarding my office, I have to interrupt because I realize I would suffer more. Oh, how painful to be always alone, in doubts and in fears in making decisions! 109 I run to my Good and hear nothing; it seems as if everything is a reproach of what I do. It is true that at the end my God || works for me because in perplexities without realizing I find that matter completed and set up. I can assure that only the strength of my God could sustain me in such a terrible state.

A human creature could not stand and I would never advise to have a thought without exposing it to the director. This is a soul who desires to run the way of perfection and of mortification and to do the will of God in everything.

110 The director is of much relief, a || certainty, a support not to fall but to walk always straight till the mountain of consummation.

My Love, I say that you are in me and I in you on the cross without support for my painful headache.

“How much the monster studies!

It would put me into pieces”

18 November. I do not know how much the monster studies; it showed me clearly how in these days I will have much painful persecution, all stuff moved by the one who does not give up working night and day. 111 The sight made me tremble and I imagined what I will be in the || struggle; it was so furious against me that it would put me into pieces, if it was given power.

It seemed to me to have remained without blood, that I was much frightened to see it near an arm jumping. Oh, how one can never be used to the sights, to the fears of this filthy monster! I go on thinking – who could it be? Which side does it come from? How could I be freed?

But I can understand nothing; only praying to my God so that he may come to my help and undo what the enemy wants to do in || the Work.

112 Oh, my Love, how one suffers when she expects without knowing what will come, I feel not to be alone; but this poor humanity is afflicted immensely and I do not know how to subject it more to what I keep oppressed.

A conference on the love of God for the novices

22 November. Today I felt lost and only the mercy of my

God saved me because I had promised to do the conference on the love of God. 113 Poor me! When I started to say how this || love begins and we are all sure to be loved, because faith teaches us, my God, only he could say what happened in me:

with his grace I was able to distract myself with a story.

My embarrassment was such that I saw everything upside down. Oh, I will never return to such an argument, I was truly frightened!5

How those ugly beasts made me suffer last night! Oh, my Love, have pity for my head! How I suffered!

I was sleeping and the pain was such that I felt || that I lamented loudly. 114 And it is curious: this lament I made woke me well. It is a very persistent suffering that I do not know how to arrest or rather to calm the nerves. One feels a sensible torment that is a painful suffering but always dear because everything is for Jesus.

A sister who thought she had a vocation for the cloister

25 November. 115 It is something horrible the fear that the infernal beasts put upon me. They take away sleep, they filled my mind with a thousand turbulences || upsetting me with fear at the sight of skeletons. Finally they nailed in my mind a very horrible thought… Certainly it is a very strong pain because it is as if I had before me what comes into my mind.

I do not speak of noises, of the shakings that I receive while lying down. These are my nights, how tired I feel! In the morning I do not know how to stand on my feet.

It was curious what happened to me regarding a superior who was to enter into a cloister. My God, perhaps I was displeased? 116 Not at all! A || creature who is inclined to greater perfection is of much consolation; important is that she is not deluded by the devil, because to my judgment it is fantasy and nothing else. With the head warmed by books, very high for her, and not understanding well what perfection means; she believes it consists in being lost for hours in confession and then some badly arranged penances…

But where am I lost to make descriptions! 117 I will only say that I was clearly notified that with her upset || she gave up any concern for the house. What a pain when I knew this, my God!

I called her immediately and I made sure that whatever

I felt interiorly was true. Poor!

Seeing that she was discovered, she confessed to me everything. My God, what would have ever happened if she had done it without our knowledge. While I could have given her a thousand permissions, not one to achieve that!

118 She remained surprised and would have liked to know || who had told me.

I thank God continually who with much charity is deigned to suggest to his slave. In the same way I realize what goes on in the sister who is near me; how I feel pain!

I cannot tell her anything if she does not ask me for clarification first on her unrest; she thinks she is calm while she has interior anxiety.

119 I was not mistaken on the one who wanted to go to cloister; I wanted to help her || to achieve her desire but she stopped and she did not want anymore. She remained with her head upside down and it needed much to calm her.

Poor creature, how I feel pain for her!

Explanation she received on the permanent pain in one point of her head

Today 28 November. The Spiritual Exercises had started. What the ugly monster tries to do is something frightening but I hope with the help of my God to bring it back and in this way to bring victory.

120 Yesterday, while I prayed for certain quarrels and tribulations of family which arose to make me exercise a bit of patience – what gave me more pain was that these people try to molest the Work of the Lord – this is how I prayed to a soul who laughing || said:

It is almost all ended; poor mother, everything is won.

Oh, what pleasure I felt to hear this voice! May God bless you dear soul, pray for this poor mother of yours!

After saying this how I remained convinced and sure that everything will be soon concluded! It left me an interior consolation for having heard her voice and this more than anything else made me feel much consolation and also because everything will be finished. Even this consoled me especially because it concerned the Work of the Lord.

121 My poor head always on the right side || in one point pains.

How many times my dear crucifix showed me the pain he felt on this side because of a big thorn which pierced him in on the head in such a way that it left a deep completely torn hole.

Another time he made me understand that this was the pain of a nail which caused me much pain. Even now while I write it pains me in a special way.

122 But for you, my Love, the pain was much because the whole of your head was || pierced by cruel thorns.

The attraction for a life of cloister returns but the Lord is not pleased

Today is the first day of the Spiritual Exercises. As I had tested, how sweet what I felt in the solitude of my room! I am unable to describe it. What beatitude those souls who are in cloister will have! No, my Good often made me feel he does not like this thought.

123 Yes, my Love, I am happy to be as you want me to be and I bless your hand that brought || me here, because this is what you like and feel to be happy in doing your holy will, my God! I am so insensible to everything! Oh, how this slave of yours does not identify anymore her nature, such a sensible feeling that everything molests me.

For this with your help, fighting strongly I will overcome a liveliness that I find it so difficult to be calm. Oh, there was nothing that I did not go through!

124 When I think of it, my God, I see clearly that I touched with my hand your grace, which you abundantly || poured on this slave of yours! How much mercy!

I finished my confession and I was not able to understand how even the confessor was dumb.

Oh, my Love, if this is what you like, I am happy and I feel an indescribable sweetness when something oppresses me. Certainly if this could happen to all, nobody would be melancholic in the adversities.

“How difficult it is to guide a soul well!”

I see something in that sister, which I cannot express and feel much pain. 125 I would like her to remove that knot which prevents her || walking on the way of perfection. I find that in this way of doing she not only remains stationary but goes back.

How difficult to guide a soul well! It seems to me that in a flight the guide has been in some way deceived from the way in which he behaved, perhaps without realizing. In this way he blocked the journey that she had started well.

Oh, my Love, if I could explain better the state in which this soul is found it seems to me I could do it willingly || but you do not allow it. Fiat!

126 In this word I am happy and I enjoy much peace.

I suffer much from other pains, but I am always resigned to the will of God. Even pain is sweet.

My Salvatore was not mistaken at all regarding the Protector Cardinal. Oh, how good he is with the Work of the Lord! A true holy and wise Protector, so enlightened that he did much good and he does continually for the Work of the Lord.

Your words, my daughter: “Cardinal Verga will be the Protector and he will do much good in the Work of the Lord.” Blessed are you!

3MS 12. 1 – pp. 1 – 14

Sufferings of every type during the Spiritual trong>1 1st December 1891. My affliction continues and I suffer much in seeing a fault in a sister and though I tried hard to make her understand, I do not know when she will decide to wake up from lethargy.

How much I suffered in the Spiritual Exercises, I cannot describe. I have all the illnesses: the bones pained and the body seemed made of wax, such that it pained much. 2 The interior sorrow brought me horrible suffering and the tribulations of spirit increased. I would have liked to discipline myself, but I lacked strength. || Everything oppressed me.

Let even this be for you, my Good, if you wish it!

A murmur in my ears whispered that he was not pleased with my suffering. My God, perhaps what I do and suffer is not of your liking?

Even today my suffering was much for a wound that the Daughters of St. Anne opened and they pierced me. Patience!

Anxieties and night suggestions

8 December 1891: day of the Immaculate. 3 In the morning as I woke twenty minutes past four, on the bed I started my meditation on the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin. In my room I saw everything changed || suddenly. I cannot explain how and the Cardinal with whom I dealt many things regarding the Work entered. He looked at me and made some steps greeting me three times;

he had a corpse-like appearance with a languishing eye and with nothing on his head. He wore a top-coat. After having done these three greetings he disappeared.

  • Oh – I said – he is dead or he has a short time to live because when they come, it is always like that.

4 The three greetings have been || explained to me; but I do not feel it would be good to write them down. The

Cardinal was Laurenzi.6

This day was of much melancholy that I cannot think more; I would have not done anything other than weeping but I had to force myself. How I suffered! But I did not want them to realize, since there was our holy Protector

Verga.

At night how much the beasts disturbed me in the room! I had such a big blow that I was frightened.

In this way suddenly I saw black souls for whom I felt compassion. 5 At Communion || and even before I had a union and then I passed to the uproar of a thousand fears:

should I do this? No? And then I had suggestions, because

I understood very little and I saw that they were all diabolic whispers.

Presage and fears at night

12 December. I went to the chapel to receive Holy

Communion and there were also eight American sisters who had to leave for America the same day.

They received the Holy Communion with me and there was a function. 6 While these were still in the kneeler || I raised my head to prepare myself to go to receive. Alas, what I saw! The crown of thorns of Our Lord very big, but only the front side, the remaining was as if covered; it was seen as black. I felt pierced by pain that those creatures could become many thorns so big that could bring much pain to my head. 7 I did not know how to calm myself and the moment of receiving Jesus was close. ||

Oh, my Love, what will happen? I felt a strong melancholy that I carried for the whole day; at night it increased much because I had a horrible night molested by beasts which were doing things of all kinds. They shoot at me with a revolver that made me tremble out of fear thinking they were people. 8 At half past three, I saw a big beast that left me much worry and unrest without being able to understand anything. I saw other small ones here and there || in the room. It was a long time since they had come so horribly.

This morning, 16 December, while I dressed myself, they knocked on the door so strongly that I was very frightened because I was alone on that side.

I answered asking who it was and what she/he wanted. I was not given a reply. My God! 9 Such was the fear because I thought they were men, but after I was convinced that there was nobody. I understood that it was || certainly the ugly snout and I must also confess that I’ve had fears for a long time and I can say that they continue. I feel restlessness and an interior convulsion which makes me suffer a lot. Every pain makes me upset and seems to bring me even fever. How this miserable humanity is badly reduced! Some times I feel compassion because I reduced it this way making always of myself an instrument of God’s will. 10 This thought relieves me and I look at it with || pleasure and I feel it languishing.

“Oh, if my God could accept my blood as expiation for my sins!”

17 December. I suffered much, but in peace and though I had a strong headache, I did not give up disciplining myself until bleeding and I was very satisfied. Oh, if my God could accept my blood as expiation for my sins, the Miserere for the poor sinners and for other people to whom

I am obliged because of the Institute! Even today I had news of 11 a sick sister and what I thought and felt in me to be a diabolic suggestion || I found to be true.

How much pain I feel to see certain good souls to fall in certain weaknesses! What pain I feel! I am so grieved for this that I would like to be able to find the way to make them understand how they are deceived without being aware. For me, to see such blindness and not to be able to remedy is a true pain.

How the devil goes far and wide and in this case in a subtle manner it continues to get people. ||

12 Cardinal Verga: true gift of God to the Institute

20 December 1891. I had much pain for a sick person and I prayed fervently to my Sister Anne del Salvatore. She said that actually it was nothing and she joked. How consoled I was! She is always my comfort. Oh, what she said regarding the Protector Verga is verified in detail! He could have been really my support and would have worked for the community! Everything came true to the letter. ||

13 The Cardinal is for me a true comfort in tribulations; I go to him and he smoothes everything with his wisdom and holiness because calmly he carries everything I expose to him, as if they were things which do not bother him. Oh, how merciful is my dear Jesus! What happens is all out of his charity and it is planned by him.

When the Cardinal comes here, a very high person as he is, he deigns to listen to me and to comfort me and he seriously takes care of the || Work. How obliged I am to him! 14 Certainly I will never forget him eternally. I had never one like him fully dedicated to the Work of the Lord.

In the tribulations he dispels every fear; may God reward him abundantly!

I do not see anything other than sufferings and afflictions on all sides. May all be for Jesus!
